tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// rnal 'byor chen po'i sgrub thabs thams cad la nye bar mkho ba'i cho ga gsang ba kun rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rnal 'byor chen po'i sgrub thabs thams cad la nye bar mkho ba'i cho ga gsang ba kun rgyan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rmad byung tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pas// phun tshogs sku bzhi'i dpal gyis legs 'byor pa// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la gus btud nas// gsang ba spyi yi cho ga bshad kyis nyon// 'dir rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs thams cad la nye bar mkho ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya bar 'dod pas/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po la drug dang po la gnas khang brgyan par bya ba ni/ dben pa'i gnas su phyag dar dang*/ skyang nul byas pa'i dbus su slob dpon dang*/ g.yas su dpa' bo dang*/ g.yon du dpa' mo rnams kyi gdan bsham/ de rnams kyi dbus su sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal khru gang las mi chung ba/ dri bzangs kyis byugs pa la kye rdo rje'am/ bde mchog gam/ gsang 'dus sogs rnal 'byor gang byed kyi lha'i me tog gi tshom bu bkod do// gnyis pa phyi nang gi mchod pa bsham pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mthar kye rdor gsang 'dus sogs la chu gsum mam bzhi/ bde mchog sogs la chu gnyis te/ de dag sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga lha re re la bcu las mi nyung ba dang*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yon du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ g.yas su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma/ de dag gi bar du rang gi chos skyong gi gtor ma du dgos pa bshams la/ thams cad kyang sha dang chang dang bdud rtsi ril bus sbags/ de dag gi mdun du tshogs 'khor gyi rdzas/ sha dang chang dang zan la sogs pa'i bza' ba dang btung ba 'tshog tshad bzhag go /slob dpon gyi mdun gyi g.yon du nang mchod dang*/ de'i g.yas su dril bu dang*/ de'i g.yas su rdo rje dang*/ de'i g.yas su dung chos su bdud rtsi dang dri bzang sbyar ba'i chus gang dang*/

ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa bsham zhing*/ gzhan rnams kyi gdan gyi mdun du'ang bsang chu ma gtogs pa rnams tshang bar bsham mo// gsum pa rdo rje slob dpon bzhugs pa ni/ tshogs kyi slob dpon spyan drangs te/ gdan dbus ma la bzhugs pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad mchod pa'i phyir/ tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ mdun gyi bsang chu swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang chu/ rdzas kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ gtso bo gang yin gyi snying po nyer gcig dang*/ las thams cad pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas byin gyis brlab bo// bzhi ba brda dang brda'i lan bya ste nang du gzhug pa ni/ dbyug sngon can gyi nga rgyal dang cha lugs 'dzin pa'i slob dpon zhig bsang chu dang bcas pa sgo nang du 'dug pa la/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma lus dri chus khrus byas pa rnams kyis phyi nas/ khyod kyi dam tshig la ni khro bo dbyug pa sngon po mdzes// dngos grub phyag na dbyug tho rin chen bcings pa 'dzin// dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo 'du bar 'khor sgrol khums// mkha' mdzes rnal 'byor pa yi nang du bdag thongs shig /ces pas gsol ba gdab/ de nas sgo cung zad phye la/ dbyug sngon can gyis/ kastam+bho/ zhes dri/ phyi pa rnams kyis/ ka li mañdza ra/ zhes lan gdab/ po taṃ gis gzer ba la/ nang nas/ pra ti po taṃ gi ces ngag gi brda dang brda'i lan dang*/ dbyug sngon can gyis lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgrengs te ston pa 'ongs sam zhes zer ba la/ phyi pa rnams kyis g.yon pa'i gung mo dang mdzub mo gnyis gshibs nas bsgrengs te ston pa 'ongs so zhes pa'i don to// de la sogs pa'i lus kyi brda dang brda'i lan byas la/

mi shes pa rnams phyir bskrad/ shes pa rnams nang du 'ong du bcug la/ bsang chu gtor zhing*/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'du ba rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang*// rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du zo// zhes brjod/ de nas nang du 'ongs pa rnams kyis slob dpon la phyag byas la/ dbang gi rgan rim gyis gral la 'khod cing*/ sgo dam du bsdams la/ phyi nang gi 'grul bcad do// lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon nas brtsams te/ rnal 'byor pa re re'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal re re dbul zhing*/ spyir phyag phul la/ sems can don du sems dge bar// rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// tshul bzhin cho ga ldan pa yis// rnal 'byor la ni nyer gnas mdzod// ces pas gsol ba gdab pa'am/ yang na/ bla ma dag gi phyag bzhes kyi/ thog mar las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum byas te/ rdo rje slob dpon rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa la maṇ+ḍal spyir phul nas/ phyag byas te/ bla ma la bdug spos dang bcas pa'i me tog dang gzhan rnams la me tog rkyang pa dbul/ de nas phyag bya/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs/ me tog dang bcas pas rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin chen gyis// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang*// yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis bsag bya'i phyir// gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par mdzod// ces lan gsum brjod la me tog gtor/ yang phyag byas te/ bla ma ma gtogs pa'i me tog bsdu/ phyag byas te/ bla ma la tshogs kyi slob dpon zhu ba'i ched du gzhan thams cad kyis maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bla mas kyang*/ gzhan rnams kyis phul ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/ rang gis me tog bkod pas maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing*/ me tog gi snod nyid kyang maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhag la/ rten gyi drung du dbul/ de nas phyag byas te/ rang gnas su 'khod par bzhed pas de ltar bya'o// drug pa yi ge brgya pa brjod de rgyud dag par bya ba ni/

thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ste/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus da nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus byas la/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o// zhes sam/ bsdu na/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis rim pa gnyis kyi lam bsgom snyam du bsam mo// de nas bde mchog sogs ma rgyud rnams la dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod paṇa can/ rdo rje skyel krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyem ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas spras par bsam/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ yab kyi sku gang rdo rje'i lam nas brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang bas sbyor mtshams dang sku thams cad las byung ba'i bdud rtsi rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs te/ lus thams cad gang bar bsam zhing*/ sdig sgrib rnams kha dog nag po'i gzugs kyis/ bshang gci dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon par bsams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba saṃd+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka ma me muts+tsha/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nyi shu rtsa gcig nas brgya'i bar ci nus bzlas nas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pas gsol ba gdab/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa ltung ba'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes bshags sdom byas pa'i rjes la/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal kye'i rdo rje la sogs pa bsgom par 'gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur par bsam mo// gsang 'dus sogs pha rgyud rnams la/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa rgyan brgyad kyis spras shing sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyem ma sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan par bsams la/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐ bsgoms pa nas/ sdig sgrib phyir thon pa'i bar sngar bzhin bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+ri bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥ zhes bzlas pa'i mthar/ phyag 'tshal bstod cing phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud// gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /ces gsol ba btab pa'i rjes la/ bshags sdom sogs sngar bzhin bya ste sbyor ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ tshim pa drug gi dang po/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa rgyas pas tshim pa la/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor tshim pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor tshim par bya ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/

bde mchog gam gsang 'dus sogs so so'i mngon par rtogs pa rdzogs par bsgoms la/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bya ste/ so so'i gzhung du shes so// 'on kyang bzlas pa'i rjes su/ bla ma dang bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa'i gsol ba gdab dang*/ yig brgya gsum tsam bzla ba phyag len la mdzad de/ de ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang chus gtor zhing*/ so so'i las thams cad pas bsang*/ shū n+ya tā'am/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil la sogs dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur par bsams la/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyangs pa nas/ dbang bskur ba'i bar so so'i gzhung bzhin byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma tha mi dad du bsam/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar bla ma brgyud pa/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pas bskor ba bzhugs par bsam/ mchod pa dbul te/ so so'i mchod phreng du shes so// gal te mchod 'bul gyi tshig ma bshad pa'i ma rgyud rnams la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// zhes pas mchod yon dang*/

zhabs bsil sogs la 'don pa spo/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar// dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa ni// me tog de ring bzhes nas su// 'di la byin gyis brlab par gsol// oṃ tsan+dan ga bur dang bcas pa'i// dri zhim spos me dge ba ni// mthu dang bcas par bya ba ni// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab du gsol// oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba ni// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa 'joms byed pa// lha yi mig 'byed bkra shis pas// mar me khyed kyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa// sna tshogs ga pur rnam brgyan pas// sna tshogs yi ge hūm̐ las byung*// dri 'di 'bul te bzhes su gsol// kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i// bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan// thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u sogs// rnga dang dung sogs sgra dbyangs dang*// yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs kyis// he ru ka dpal sogs la 'bul// zhes brjod cing rol mo ci 'byor pa dkrol la/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li ni/ pra dzñā pā ra mi tā/ nā da saṃ bhā we ta/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod do// de bzhin du pha rgyud rnams la/ lha yi mchod yon dam pa 'dis// dkyil 'khor mchod par bgyid par 'tshal// thugs ni brtse bar nyer dgongs te// mgon pos mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /ces pas mchod yon dang*/ zhabs bsil la sogs la'ang 'don pa bsgyur ro// chu skyes de bzhin thang las skyes// me tog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu gus pas bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes// lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung*// de bzhin bdug spos mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes// zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di// lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms// mi shes thams cad zhi bya'i phyir// bdag nyid dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes// bza' dang bca' bar yang dag ldan// kha dog dri dang ro ldan zhing*// thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag

/'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs// dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di// mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul gyi// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// zhes pa bya zhing*/ gong ma gnyis ka'i tshig so so'i mtshams su/ dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi mtshan sngags dang*/ mchod pa so so'i sngags spel zhing*/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul lo// de la rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'am/ yang rdo rje khu tshur gyi gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pa mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ thal mo gnyis kha thur du bstan la 'og nas drangs te/ steng du rdo rje khu tshur du byas pa me tog gi dang*/ de nyid 'og tu bskor te/ rdo rje khu tshur bcings pa bdug spos kyi dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur las mthe bong gnyis gshibs nas brkyang pa mar me'i dang*/ thal mo steng nas 'og tu bskor ba snying gar kha phyir bstan te gyen du brkyang ba dri'i dang*/ thal mo 'og nas steng du brkyang ba gshibs te/ mthe bong gnyis nang du cung zad g.yab pa ni zhal zas kyi phyag rgya'o// de nas nang mchod kyi dbus nas mtheb srin sbyar bas blangs la/ spyi bor gtor zhing*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa la sogs pa/ kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi brgyud pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze sa ra ha/

slob dpon klu sgrub/ sha ba ri dbang phyug lo hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dza lan+dha ra/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs can/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal jo blo gros grogs pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po la sogs pa/ bde mchog lo nag gi brgyud pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ zla ba grags pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ bik+ṣa ta de ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi brgyud pa dang*/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi dbang bka'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi mtshan la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma/ brgyud pa'i bla ma/ dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'dres pa thob pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas bla ma rnams la dbul/ de nas kye rdor la sogs pa yi dam gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul zhing*/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbul lo// gnyis pa snying gar ye shes kyi lha bdud rtsi myang bas tshim pa ni/ de nas srin lag gis lce rtse smin mtshams spyi gtsug tu thig le byas pas/ lus kyi lha thams cad tshim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ de nas oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gur mgon dang*/ oṃ shrī dharmā pā la tsa turmu kha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gdong bzhi pa la sogs pa sgos kyi chos skyong gang byed la dbul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes brjod do// de nas ma rgyud rnams la/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshan+do dang nye ba'i tshan+do/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas dbul/ pha rgyud la 'di rnams kyi tshab tu/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po bzhi/ gza' dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gang rung gi mthar/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing*/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul lo// de nas so so'i gzhung bzhin du bstod pa rgyas pas bstod la/ rgyun bshags dang sdom pa bzung ba sogs byed par 'dod na/ skabs 'di nyid du bya'o// gsum pa phyi rol gyi 'byung po'i tshogs gtor mas tshim par bya ba ni/

gtor ma rnams sngar slob dpon lus kyi lha mchod pa'i bar la las kyi rdo rjes nang mchod nas gzar bus blangs pa bran zhing*/ chu dang chang blugs pas sbyangs la phyag byas te/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas dbul bar zhu/ zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis gtor ma dang po byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ mgron bskyed pa nas/ phrin las 'chol ba'i bar so so'i gzhung bzhin du bya'o// de nas gtor ma gnyis pa la/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āḥzhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa dang*/ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te/ hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas kyi gri gug g.yon pas thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis ka'i dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na lcags spyang*/ mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

de'i g.yon du ṭaṃ las e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du/ bh+yo las dpal ldan 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung*/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ska rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa dug sbrul dang*/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa shin tu rid pa/ lte ba'i thad ka na nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ lcam dral gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par mos la/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba mgon po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas te/ mdzub mo g.yab pa'am rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs// da ltar snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya e h+ye hi/

zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje thal mo kha sbyar ba lha mo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya g.yab pa'am dril bu'i sgras/ lha mo 'dir gshegs la sogs dang*/ ma hā kā la de wī/ e h+ye his spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dbyer med du bstim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wi ye/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pad+yaṃ swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod la/ so so'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la spyi bor bzhag par mos te/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wi/ sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyong*/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i 'chad pas bcad pa dang*/ bskrad cing gzir ba dang dbye ba dang bsdigs shing spa bkong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzod cig ces phrin las bcol/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā lī de wi/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/

zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ gong ltar mchod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a paṣa tsi ma ka lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tīdzñā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying po dang*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba dh+wot+sī kā ma la rak+ṣa sī hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ zhes lha mo'i snying pos nang mchod gtor/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa'i// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che// gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas// g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod// thod phreng can la bdag bstod do// khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yos// 'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel// dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i// dam tshig can la bdag bstod do// zhes pas bstod/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la ye// lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che// ma hā de wa'i sras po drag shul can// tshogs bdag chen po ma hā kā la ye// 'jigs byed chen po ma hā kā la ye// legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum brtsegs dgra// bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma nag po che// chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che// dam tshig can gyi dgra bla nag po che// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dzam+bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /sman rag phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyen por 'bul// da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyen por bzhes// 'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po// thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs// zhes pa dang*/

bh+yo gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus// 'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas// 'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod// dpal ldan lha mo khyod kyi sku// ri rab lhun po lta bur brjid// dbang po sngon po lta bur 'bar// nyi ma'i 'od ltar sprul pa 'gyed// dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar// spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khrug /mi ro khar bcug mche ba gtsigs// khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*// 'jigs pa'i mtshon chas phyag rnams bral// mi mgo rin chen rus pas brgyan// klu dbang seng ge lcags sgrog dang*// khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan// ko rlon re lde gos su gyon// bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo rgyu// shin tu rid cing mi sdug ma// 'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangs// 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra sgrogs pas// khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas// sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la 'dud// khyod thugs zhi la rab gzhol yang*// snying rje'i dbang gis srid la bzhugs// khro dang 'khrugs dang rngam pa yis// bdud dpung nges par 'joms la 'dud// dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /la sogs pas bstod cing phrin las gzhol lo// de nas gtor ma gsum pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥsngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun du paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa rtsa zhal brtsegs ma gnyis nag po/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag phyag bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas rus phreng 'phyar thabs su mdzad pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ma mchu 'phyangs pa/

thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ drag la rngam pa'i cha lugs can/ ngag tu ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ dang k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ gis sgra sgrogs par bsam/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo nag mo/ rgyab tu siṅga li ma ser nag bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rgyan med pa rab tu grims shing khros pa'i cha lugs can/ g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor lnga'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ti se bsil ba'i tshal po ta la ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas ye shes pa spyan drangs par mos la/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// gtum po khyod kyis ci ltar khas blangs bzhin// phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kā la rā tṛ ta/ ḍom+bi nī tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ rak+ṣa sī/ siṃ ga lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye his spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kā la rā tṛ ta/ ḍom+bi nī tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ rak+ṣa sī/ siṃ ga lī de wī sa ma ya sma ra nas/ phrin las bcol ba'i bar dang*/ de wī'i rjes su/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa btags la/ sngar bzhin gtor ma dbul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod de/ de wi'i rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la phud kyis mchod de/ dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing*// mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyangs shugs che ba// sgra sgrogs dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi// gzhon nu'i lus can bgegs 'joms khyod la 'dud// du ma'i ming can drag po'i phreng ba can// nyi zla 'bar ba'i mig gis bdud 'joms shing*// brkyang bskum glog stong 'gyur 'dra'i khro gnyer can// mdung thung gri gug bum thod 'dzin la bstod// 'jigs byed myur 'gro tshangs skud mi mgo yi// phreng ba 'dzin cing sa gsum skrag byed pa// k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ sgra sgrog srin po'i gzugs 'dzin pa// dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba khyod la bstod// dpal ldan gru 'dzin chen po na// khyod bzhugs ti se'i gangs ri la// gdong bzhi ldan khyod zhing skyong mdzad// kun srung khyod la bstod par bya// ha ha'i gad rgyangs 'brug sgra sgrogs// hūm̐ hūm̐ sgrog pa'i dpal khyod kyis// srid gsum gnas pa'i bgegs rnams kun// skrag mdzad khyod la bstod par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru// dam bcas don de da lta 'dir// bsgrubs la thogs pa med gyur pa'i// dam tshig ldan khyod bstod par bgyi// sha chen zan dang me tog spos// chang phud sha khrag la dga' ba// khyod ni byang na rab bzhugs kyang*// phyogs bcur dbang byed khyed la bstod// g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang*// siṅga la ni rnal 'byor ma// dmar dang ljang nag khros pa'i zhal// gri gug thod 'dzin bstod par bgyi// khyod kyis rang phyogs legs bsrungs shing*// gzhan phyogs rnam par sun 'byin pa// don gnyis sgrub pa'i yab yum la// bdag gis rtag tu bstod par bgyi// de ltar bstod pas rab bsngags pa// bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang*// 'dod pa thams cad bsgrub pa dang*// bgegs rnams ma lus med par mdzod// khyod kyis bsgrub pa'i las byas shing*// rjes su bsgrubs na brtse ba dang*// yongs su bsten na dgyes pa dang*// sun 'byin rnam par gzhom par mdzod// klog pa rnams ni rgyas pa dang*// kha ton phun sum tshogs pa dang*// bsgrub pa dri ma med pa yis// bstan pa dag kyang dar bar mdzod// mdor na gang dang gang bcol ba// de dang de yi las rnams la// btang snyoms g.yel ba ma mdzad par// bdag la rjes su brtse bar mdzod// ces pas bstod/

de nas gtor ma bzhi pa dkyil 'khor so so nas bshad pa'i 'byung po'i gtor mas bsngo/ ma bshad pa'i ma rgyud rnams la/ bde mchog nas bshad pa ltar/ mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor mas btang ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bcings la/ phaiṃ/ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki n+yi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥs spyan drangs/ sngar bzhin phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ prai ta/ pi shā tsi/ un+mā da/ a pasmā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i ma ba liṃ griṃh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ti krā ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta yā sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ mchod pas mchod la/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/ces pas phrin las gzhol lo// yang pha rgyud kyi cho ga spyi'i gtor ma bshad pa rnams la/ gsang 'dus nas 'byung ba 'di bya ste/ gtor ma byin brlab sngar bzhin byas la/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs skyong 'byung po'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs la/ de dag gis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ sngar gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ da sha di ka bya bas+thi te bh+yaḥ i ha a bas+thi te bh+ya sh+tsa de wa nā ga yak+ṣa/ ga na dharba a sū ra ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra ma ho ra ga bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ ud+mān+da a pasma ra/ ostā ra ka ā di bh+yo/ ba liṃ dā pa yā mi gṛ hī dwā/ su kha sau ma na s+ya la ghi no bha wan+tu/ s+thā naṃ tsa ni ru pa dra baṃ kurban+tu/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha ne na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ a mṛ ta piṇ+ḍaṃ bhuk+ta ma ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya shān+ti kurban+tu swa sti swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyi rjes la/ oṃ phyogs bcur rnam par gnas rnams dang*// 'dir ni kun tu gnas pa dang*// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*// dri za lha min nam mkha' lding*// mi'am ci dang lto 'phye che// 'byung po yi dwags sha za dang*// smyo byed dang ni brjed byed dang*// gnon po la sogs pa rnams la// gtor ma 'bul gyis bsnams nas kyang*// bde dang yid bde thob gyur cig /gnas 'dir nyer 'tshe med par mdzod// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bdud rtsi yi// bza' ba la ni longs spyod nas// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā zhes pas bsngo zhing phrin las gzhol lo// de nas lnga pa gzhi bdag dbang thob cing*/ gsang mchod bstan pas ltung ba mi 'byung ba yin na nang du bsngo ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gtor ma bdud rtsir bskyed/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul nas/

slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phud gtor la/ gtor ma 'di gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// mchod do// mgron no// sbyin no// gsol lo// bstan pa dar ba dang 'jig rten du bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod do// dbang ma thob pa'i gzhi bdag la gtor ma ster na/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol du song la/ gtor ma chang phal pa dang chus sbyang zhing*/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti ā kar+ṣā ya dzaḥ zhes pas bkug a kā ro lan gsum brjod pas tshim par bsams la/ gnas bdag yul bdag 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis bsngo zhing phrin las bcol la/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ bdag cag dpon slob chos sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du 'gro bar gyis shig ces brjod la/ khro bo'i sngags dang rol mo drag tu bya zhing*/ gtor ma lam gyi bzhi mdor dor la/ rtsa sngags sogs shub bur bzla zhing nang du 'jug go /bzhi pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag nang gi sbyin sreg gis tshim pa ni/ de nas slob dpon gyi rang gi gnas gsum du rdo rje dang bcas pa'i bsang gtor gyi thig le byas la/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlab/ gzhan rnams la'ang slob dpon gyis de ltar bya ba'am rang gis byas kyang rung*/ las kyi rdo rjes thams cad la me tog gi thod dang*/ ga sha dang mchod pa sna tshogs dbul/ de tsam ma grub na/ thun mong du nyer spyod lnga bshams la/ phyag sngon du 'gro bas/

kye rdo rjer bsgoms pa yin na/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes pa la/ mchod pa so so'i sngags sbyar la/ rol mo dang bcas pas dbul/ de bzhin du/ dkyil 'khor gzhan la'ang 'gre'o// de nas tshogs kyi longs spyod thams cad mdun du 'dus byas nas/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag byas la/ tshogs kyi yo byad byin brlab mdzad par zhu// zhes brjod cing*/ nang mchod nas gzar bus bcus la/ bza' btung thams cad la khyab par gtor/ thams cad kyi de rnams gtor ma ltar bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ ha ho hrīḥmang du brjod/ slar yang bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ zag med kyi bdud rtsir yang yang bsam mo// de nas chang la sogs pa'i btung ba thams cad kyi phud thod par bsdus pa dang*/ sha la sogs pa'i bza' ba thams cad kyi phud bsdus la cha gnyis su byas pa'i cha gcig thod par bcug la/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du bzhag la phyag byas nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la phud dbul bar zhu/ zhes brjod pa dang*/ kun gyis 'das pa'i lha'i gtor sngags lan gsum brjod la tshogs phud dbul/ cha gcig 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma rnams la bzhag cing*/ chang gis bran la/ so so'i gtor sngags gsum re brjod pas dbul te/ tshogs 'khor gyi cha dang po la'o// de nas rang lhar gsal bar bsgom pa'i kha hom khung dang*/ lag pa gnyis hūm̐ las rdo rje'i gzar bu gnyis dang*/ lte bar raṃ las gtum mo 'bar ba'i me lce'i khrod na 'jig rten pa'i tshogs dang*/ snying gar paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang rang gi lus kyi phung khams skye mched rnams kyang lhar gsal bar bsgoms la/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa cung zad bya zhing*/ lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang*/ tha mal gyi rtog pa 'gyur nges su bsgom pa ni/ cha gnyis pa'o// de nas yon bdag dam tshig dang ldan pa yin na/ des phyag byas la/

maṇ+ḍal phul thal mo sbyar te/ byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol// bdag gis tshogs mchod khyad 'phags 'di// dang ba'i sems kyis 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// zhes gsol ba btab cing me tog gtor/ gal te yon bdag dam tshig dang mi ldan na/ tshogs gral du 'ong du mi btub pas/ de'i tshab las kyi rdo rjes bya/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ e ma ho ye shes chen po rnams// tshogs chen 'bar bas nyon mongs bsregs// 'di 'dra'i bde ba thob nas ni// kun gyis a ho su kha brjod// ces brjod pa'i rjes su/ thams cad kyis/ a ho su kha bhak+ṣā nāṃ/ a ho su kha prā ya nāṃ/ ma hā mu tra sid+dhi naṃ/ pra brta nṛr ten naṃ/ hūm̐ ha ha ho ho/ zhes brjod/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes/ thams cad kyi mdun du thod pa'am ma 'byor na/ thod par bsams pa'i snod chang gis bkang bar bzhag la/ slob dpon la phyag dang pad skor dang*/ gzhan rnams la pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ thod pa lag pa g.yas pas bzung*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis sha cung zad bzung*/ thod pa'i steng nas dgab ste/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// zhes sogs brjod/ len pa pos kyang*/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod cing*/ gnyis kas/ a ho su kha/ zhes brjod la/ las kyi rdo rjes dam tshig ma thob kyi bar du lag tu bzung*/ dam tshig thob pa dang stegs kyi steng du bzhag de nas sha la sogs pa'i bza' ba rnams/ slob dpon la nyis 'gyur dang*/ gzhan rnams la che chung med par rim gyis drang*/ stob pa pos kyang*/ a ho su kha/ zhes brjod cing lag pa gnyis kas bstab/ len pa pos kyang a ho su kha zhes brjod cing blangs la/ bza' btung rnams stegs med par sa la mi bzhag yo byad thams cad bstabs tshar ba dang*/

bde mchog pa yin na/ lag mchod skabs 'dir byas la/ kha zas kyi phud kyis dkon mchog dang yi dam mchod cing*/ 'phrog ma la sogs la'ang chang bu byin la/ rang lha'i 'du shes dang rnam pa ma 'khrul ba'i ngang nas nang gi sbyin sreg gsal btab la tshim par bza' 'o// 'dir rab tu byung ba sdom brtson rnams kyis tshogs 'khor byed na/ gong 'og gi cho ga thams cad 'dra ba las/ dam tshig blangs te lce la reg pa tsam bya/ bu ram dang sbrang rtsi dang zhun mar rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlabs la/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du bza'o// rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis kyang dam tshig gi rdzas la ran par longs spyad kyi/ chang myos kyi bar du 'thung ba dang*/ kha zas ha cang rgyag par longs spyad pa ni/ tshogs 'khor gyi skabs kyi dgag bya yin la/ khyad par bsad sha la longs spyod pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud mtha' dag las bkag pas/ dgra nag dang a ral+li'i rgyud sogs nas bshad pa ltar ba glang sogs rang shi ba'i sha kho na tshogs 'khor gyi dam rdzas su gzung ngo*// de ltar mchod pa dang longs spyod la tshim par longs spyad/ zas la dpyas mi dgas par mang du bza'/ skom ji snyed pa btung*/ snod stongs par mi bzhag zas sa rjen la mi bzhag tshogs kyi gtso bo la snod gnyis/ gzhan la re re/ bde mchog ltar nas thams cad snod gcig tu bza'/ snod mu dang khad chad du mi dgang*/ 'dren pa dang len pa thams cad lag pa gnyis kas drang zhing*/ gnyis kas blang zhing tshogs kyi gtso bo la 'dren pa dang len pa na phyag bya/ 'gro na tshogs kyi gtso bo la phyag byas te zhu/ 'ongs pa na phyag bya/ gzhan yang bya ba zhu ba thams cad phyag byas te zhu/ spyod lam gyi shugs kyis 'gro dgos pa byung na mi dgag brel pa gzhan byung nas 'gro dgos na mkhyen par gsol/ bzod par gsol te 'gro/ rtsod pa byed pa byung na gdon/ 'don ma nus na rang gzhan du 'gro/ gtso bos bka' ma bsgos par stan la mi 'dug

glu gar dang rol mo dang*/ dris lan dang ma legs par smra bar mi bya/ rkang pa brkyangs te mi 'dug lus ma bsdams par mi 'dug bza' btung dang rnal 'byor pho mo la chags par mi bya/ 'jigs pa dang dogs pa dang ngo tsha ba dang*/ gtsang mi gtsang gis rnam rtog dang*/ bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog la 'dzem par mi bya/ rnal 'byor pho mo la ma gus pa dang skur ba mi gdab/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs la skrag par mi bya/ zas la skom pa dang chags pa dang 'tshag gi phyir mi bza'/ 'du 'dzi'i gtam dang nyan thos kyi bslab bya dang*/ rigs ngan dang smad 'tshong ma'i gtam mi bya/ nyon mongs pa'i sems mi bskyed/ las dang po pas kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag ste/ spyod pa gang yang ma dag par mi bya/ zas kyis lus ma 'byangs pa dang*/ gtor ma ma mthong bar phyir mi 'gro/ ma zhus pa dang bsngo ba smon lam ma byas par mi nyal/ yon bdag gis kyang bza' btung gi tshim par mi 'gyur ba'i mgron spyan mi drangs/ spyan drangs pa rnams bza' btung gis tshim par bya/ phan tshun rtsod pa dang shags mi bya/ nang du zhugs pa rnams kyis gsang thub par bya'o// de la sogs pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi bslab bya rgyas par gzhung rnams las shes par bya ba ni cha gsum pa'o// de nas slob dpon de kho na nyid kyis don la cung zad mnyam par bzhag la/ skabs 'dir yon bdag tshogs bsag pa'i phyir/ don thabs shes rab dang ldan pa'i chos zab mo bshad par gsungs pa las/ dpal rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum gyis/ byang chub kyi sems bka' stsal pa 'di ltar gda'/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sa bon gyi thig le thos nas/ sems gsal ba bsgrub pa nye bar gyur nas tshig 'di dag gsungs pa/ sems pa med cing bsgom pa med// sngags med lha yang med pa ste// sems kyi rdo rje las byung ba// 'di ni byang chub rim brtan pa'o// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dam tshig gi de skad ces bka' stsal to// bsod nams med cing sdig pa'ang med// byang chub med cing sangs rgyas med// ye shes lnga yi sbyor ba yis// byang chub sems 'di brtan pa'o// bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to// sngags med bzlas pa'ang yod ma yin// 'khor ba gsum po thams cad med// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis// bsgom pa dang ni bsgom pa med// bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to// kun rdzob 'jig rten pa yang yod// dpyad na gang du 'jig rten pa// rtag tu 'jig rten pa nyid 'khor// 'di ni byang chub rim brtan pa'o// bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to// ma skyes pa dang mi dmigs pa// mi phyed nam mkha' lta bu ste// zab cing zhi ba'i rang bzhin ni// 'di ni byang chub rim brtan pa'o// bcom ldan 'das ral gri'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to// sgyu ma ji ltar me long ltar// nam mkha' ci ltar bde ji ltar// ci ltar dngos po yongs shes pa// 'di ni byang chub rim brtan pa'o// bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro ma bdag med mas de skad ces bka' stsal to// stong nyid dri med dam pa'i gnas// rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nyid// ji srid ma zhig bar du ni// sems kyi rang bzhin bsgom par gyis// mā ma kī'i 'o// srid med mya ngan 'das pa'ang med// 'di ni bde chen rdo rje ste// gang zhig yid kyis bsgom pas bsgom// de ni mchog gi bsgom pas bsgom// spyan gyi'o// sngags dang yi ge rnam par spangs// de ni sems med thig le med// 'di de dam pa'i bde chen te// bri ba med cing gang ba med// gos dkar mo'i 'o// gzugs brnyan rang bzhin ji lta bar// de ltar dngos po bsgom par bya// stong nyid dri med mchog gi gnas// der ni bsod nams sdig pa med// sgrol ma'i 'o// ji ltar chu nang zla ba de// bden min brdzun pa min pa ste// de ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ni// lus kyi rang bzhin rnyog pa med// 'khor thams cad kyis de skad ces bka' stsal to// zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don la thugs mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/

rig pa 'dzin pa so so nas kyang rgyud kyi tshig zab mo re gsung bar zhu/ zhes brjod cing*/ gzhan rnams kyis kyang go rim bzhin du/ chos cung zad bshad pa ni gsung gi 'khor lo'o// lnga pa phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams glu gar gyis tshim pa ni/ de nas glu gar bya bar 'os pa la/ slob dpon gyis bka' stsal zhing*/ de rnams kyis kyang lha'i dmigs pa brtan pos/ bdag dang tshogs pa rnams bsrung ba'i phyir/ skyes pas glu len pa 'od dpag med dang*/ gar byed pa rnam snang gi nga rgyal dang*/ bud med glu len pa na gos dkar mo dang*/ gar byed pa na spyan ma'i nga rgyal gyis/ rdo rje'i glu gar rgyas par bya ba'am/ de tsam ma grub na/ sngar gyi a ho su kha sogs rkang pa bzhi pa la glu gar bya ba ni sku'i 'khor lo'o// drug pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis tshim pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa rlung gi nus pa dang ldan pa rnams la ni/ yon bdag gis rang dbang ba'i phyag rgya phul la/ de dang lhan cig yol ba'i nang du pho nya'i lam bsgoms pas/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur la/ de'i ngang la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag go /rlung gi nus pa dang mi ldan pa'am/ rab byung rnams kyis ni snying gar mar gyi nying khu'am/ ma da na blugs la cung zad mnyes te/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum du bsgom pa snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam pa ni thugs kyi 'khor lo ste/ dngos gzhi tshim pa drug go /gsum pa rjes la drug gi dang po phyi rol gyi 'byung po la phrin las gzhol ba'i phyir/ lhag ma'i gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ bza' btung gi lhag ma rnams snod chen po cig gi nang du mas rim gyis bsdus la/ gtso bo'i drung du bzhag la phyag byas te/ lhag ma'i gtor ma byin brlab mdzad par zhu/ zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis ma da na cung zad 'thung ste/

lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgyar byas pa'i nang du/ ngag tu bh+rūm̐ zhes pa'am/ phaiṃ zhes brjod pa dang bstun la/ gtor ma la kha phru gdab/ de nas cung zad kyang bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭha/ ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun brjod pa'am/ a kā ros bsngos la se gol gtogs/ des lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad tshim par bsams la/ mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar dang bcas pas lhag ma lam gyi bzhi mdor dor ro// gnyis pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma bsdus te bkra shis par bya ba ni/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ kol+la i reṭaṭhi a bo lā/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ gha ṇe kṛ pi ṭa ho bādz+dza i/ ka ru ṇe ki a i/ na ro wā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza i/ gāḍheṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dza i/ ha le kā liñdzar pa ṇi a i/ dun+dur pādz+dzi a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu rī sih+lā/ kāp+pu ra lā i a i/ mā la in+dha ṇa sā lañdza/ ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i/ phreṃ kha ṇa kha ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dha na mu ṇi a i/ ni raṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun+dhu ru bā ṭa i/ ḍin+ti ma ta hin+na bādz+dzi a i/ zhes pas rdo rje'i glu blang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin// de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thob pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge pa'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsams pa dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*// bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis// bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*// rgyud ni nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*// snyan pa nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa ste// gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*// 'dod pa grub cing phun sum tshogs pa ste// bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yi// lnga po des kyang der 'dir bde legs shog /spyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*// mnyam par 'jog cing shes rab bskyed pa ste// drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyin mo'i gung la bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces brjod/ dam tshig gso ba'i cho ga byed na/ skabs 'di'am/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gtong ba'i rjes la bya'o// gsum pa lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa brjod pa ni/ sems kyis sdig pa thams cad bshags pa dang*/ cho ga lhag chad kha bskang bar bsams la/ yi ge brgya pa brgya rtsa gcig la sogs pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// zhes sogs dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces pa dang*/ gang yang bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag du gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ bying ba dang rgod pa dang*/ cho ga'i yo byad ma tshang ba dang*/ lhag pa dang*/ nyams pa dang*/ phyin ci log tu gyur pa thams cad bzod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod do// bzhi pa las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i smon lam gdab pa ni/ yon bdag gis gser la sogs pa'i yon slob dpon la nyis 'gyur dang*/ gzhan rnams la mnyam par phul nas/ maṇ+ḍal byas nas/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar la/

rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol// khyed la rab tu dwang ba yis// mchod pa'i tshogs ni rab phul bas// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spangs nas ni// bde chen rdo rje 'dzin rgyal shog /ces brjod cing tshogs pa thams cad mthun 'gyur bya/ gal te sbyin bdag gis bsngo ba mi shes na/ slob dpon gyis/ bsod nams mthar thug tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis gtso byas/ dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams la brten nas/ sems can thams cad kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pa gyis/ zhes brjod la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' bklas pa'i// lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs// myur du bsgrub ste tshe 'di kho na la// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas par shog /ces pa tsam mam/ bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pa// nam mkha' mthas klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur te// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid shog /ces pa lan gsum gyis mthar thug sangs rgyas su bsngos la/ bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob par// skye dang skye ba gnas bzang por// rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang*// grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la sgrin// rnam par dag cing rgyud gcig la// skal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan pa// thos nas legs par ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod paṇa 'chang*// lag pas thabs shes rdo dril 'dzin// ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas// yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing*// sgrub la bar chad med pa dang*// bstan la bya ba byed par shog

/ces pa gnas skabs kyi dang*/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gis lam kyi grol gyur pa// de yis sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces sems can gyi don du bsngos la/ slar yang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po la sogs pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can thams cad gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig da ltar zhal bzhugs pa'i skyes bu dam pa rgyud sde bzhi la klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo mdzad pa rnams sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring bar gyur cig rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i sgrub pa po thams cad kyis lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig de dag gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu la brten nas/ sbyin bdag che ge zhes bgyi bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ lus dang longs spyod dang skal ba dang dge ba sgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig ces sam/ che ge'i rim pa gnyis kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces sogs sbyin bdag gi 'dod pa'i don la lan bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig tu smon lam gdab/ gzhan yang sa phyogs 'di nyid kyis gtso byas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'khrug long dang*/ rims nad med cing lo legs pa dang bkra shis pa la sogs pa'i dge legs thams cad kyis khyab par gyur cig

mar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyang chos dge ba bcu la gnas shing rdo rje theg pa'i snod du gyur cig bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ci ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces sogs kyis bsngo ba dang smon lam rgya cher byas la/ yon bdag spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir// e ma sems can chen po khyod// deng nas sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni// khyod la rab tu dgongs 'gyur zhing*// sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur bas na// 'bras bu chen po mthong nas ni// yid ches pa yis brtson par byos// zhes brjod do// gsung gi 'khor lo nas smon lam gyi bar ni cha bzhi pa'o// lnga pa mdun bskyed kyi mgron gshegs su gsol te gtor ma gtong ba ni/ mdun gyi lha la mchod pa bsang sbyangs sngon du 'gro bas/ phyi nang yid las byung bas mchod cing*/ bstod pa la sogs pa so so'i gzhung bzhin byas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang*/ gnas skabs su byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang*/ rim pa gnyis kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes dngos grub blang*/ de nas yig brgya lan gsum gyi rjes su/ ma 'byor pa sogs dang*/ khyed kyis sems can gyi khams la rjes su brtse bas bka' stsal zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi byin gyis brlabs te/ sems can gyi don mdzad na/ so so skye bo rnal 'byor la dbang ma thob pa rnams/ brjed ngas pas yo byad ma tshang ba la nyes pa gang cung zad gyis pa de dag bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sogs yod na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du ye shes pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

bye brag tu'ang bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig pa de srid du/ ye shes pa rnams brtan par bzhugs nas/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas brtan bzhugs bya/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol ba'am/ spro na gtor ma rnams sa gtsang sar khyer la/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la dang*// dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i// dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas// mkha' lding bya khyi lcags spyang 'khor dang bcas// pu tra la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs brgyan gyi rjes su/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod// ces pas btang la mgron gshegs par bsam mo// drug pa bdag nyid bsrungs te las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya ba ni/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa sogs rang rang gi gzhung bzhin byas nas/

chos bdag med pa'i don la mnyam par gzhag pas ngal bsos la/ me tog gi phreng ba sogs bsdu zhing*/ lus la thig le bkod pa rnams kyang phyis la/ slob dpon gyis tshul 'di gzhan la smras na/ dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mthong bar 'gyur bas/ khyed rnams kyis su la yang smra bar ma byed cig ces gsang bar gdams la/ rdzas dman pa rnams chu bor dor la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// gang gi tshe dpa' mo lha'i rnal 'byor brtan zhing dam tshig dang ldan pa ma rnyed pa de'i tshe/ sngar gyi g.yon gral la yang dpa' bo rnams bzhag cing*/ cho ga thams cad sngar bzhin ma tshang ba med par bya ba ni dpa' bo'i ston mo ste/ de'i tshe tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes mi brjod do// yang bde mchog lus dkyil lta bu mdun bskyed med pa rnams la ni/ mdun gyi rten bca' ba dang*/ mdun bskyed sgrub mchod rnams bor la/ bdag bskyed kyi rjes la gtor ma man chad sngar bzhin byas te/ 'di la mdun bskyed med pa'i phyir/ tshogs 'khor du bya dgos kyi/ dpa' bo'i ston mor mi rung*/ gang yang lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ tshogs 'khor gyi tshig tsam dang*/ cho ga la ma byang bar tshogs gral du 'jug pa ni/ rdzun gyi rnal 'byor nga rgyal byed pa'i sbom po 'byung bar bshad la/ rang lha'i ting nge 'dzin dang bral bas zos na/ dud 'gro'i gnas su skye bar gsungs shing*/ tshogs 'khor byas nas zas hub sgra can du za ba sogs bslab bya phra mo dang yang 'gal na/ mnar med pa'i dmyal bar skye bar bshad pas/ sngon du bskyed rim la brtan par bya ba dang*/ tshogs kyi bslab bya rnams la mkhas par sbyang ba sogs lag len dgos phyogs nas byed pa ni/ rang nyid la phan pa kho nar 'dom pa'i snying gtam yin no// de'i phyir bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa bsrung*// nang du 'dus pa'i don la mkhas// zhes bka' stsal pa'ang*/ ston pa thugs rje chen pos gdul bya rnams la phan pa kho nar gsung pa yin no// gsang ba'i spyod pa 'di dag 'chol bar spyad na 'jig rten tha mal pa dang*/

mu stegs 'chol pa 'ga' zhig gi spyod pa dang thun mong bar 'gyur zhing*/ de la brten nas khyim pa rnams ma dad pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa la zhugs pa rnams la gzhan gyis brnyas par 'gyur la/ rgyu de la brten nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan la gnod par 'gyur bas/ bag yod pa nan tan du bya zhing don mkhas par shes pa gal che bas/ rgyud 'grel dang tshogs 'khor gyi gzhung mtha' dag la nan tan bya/ de tsam mi nus na kho bos byas pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi rnam gzhag tu zhib tu 'dri bar 'gyur bas der shes par bya'o// rgya chen bsod nams tshogs kyi mthar thug pa// gang gis tshul bzhin spyad na tshe 'di la// bla med byang chub nges par thob byed pa'i// gsang ba spyi yi cho ga tshogs 'khor 'di// rgya chen thos pas phyi yi sgro 'dogs bcad// zab don bsgoms pas nang gi rtogs pa rgyas// thugs rjes 'gro la phan pa lhur len pa// bshes gnyen mkhas pa grags pa rin chen gyis// gsung gis yang yang bskul ba la brten nas// shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos bkod// de yi dge bas mtha' yas skye dgu rnams// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas thob par shog /rnal 'byor chen po'i sgrub thabs thams cad la nye bar mkho ba'i cho ga gsang ba kun rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos grub chen ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i gzhung dang dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyi phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong bsod nams rin chen no// // ༄༅// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga kun bzang rnam rol bzhugs so// ༈ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams las byung ba'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga kun bzang rnam rol zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// stong nyid chos dbyings khang brtsegs yangs pa'i rtser// 'od gsal lha dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor rnams// 'gyur med bde ba'i gar gyis rnam rol pa'i// khyab bdag he ru ka la bdag phyag 'tshal// rnam mang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las// rnam mkhyen myang 'das skam sar phyin 'dod nas// rnam dag tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'dir zhugs nas// rnam grol dngos grub tshe 'dir bsgrub par rigs// de lta'i rma med lam mchog bde zhing myur// sras bcas rgyal ba'i ring lugs bla na med// skal bzang bsngags pa'i dga' ston tshogs 'khor lo'i// cho ga kun bzang rnam rol 'dir bshad bya// 'dir sngags dang sman gyis kun du byin gyis brlab pa'i dug yongs su bsten pa ni/

zas dang sman gzhan pas bcud dang phan yon che ba ltar/ gang gis yongs su gdung bar 'gyur ba 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang kun nas nyon mongs pa de dang de dag thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis byin gyis brlabs nas yongs su spyad na/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang nyon mongs pa la mi mthun pa'i phyogs su lta ba de dag las khyad par du 'phags pa nyid do// de nyid kyi phyir nyan thos kyi sde snod las/ 'dod pa dang 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams dug dang mtshon cha dang chom rkun dang rab tu 'bar ba'i me dang 'dra bar shin tu smad par bstan pa de nyid/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ thabs kyis yongs su zin na lam gyi grogs su 'gyur bar gsungs te/ ci skad du yum las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la la ni thabs mkhas pas sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la yongs su spyad de/ chung ma'i 'khor gyi nang nas rnam par byung nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rtogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes gsungs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las ni/ lam gyi dngos gzhir gsungs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ chags can ye shes 'dod pa yis// rtag tu 'dod yon lnga rnams bsten// zhes dang*/ kye rdo rjer/ skye bo mi bzad pa yi las// gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba// thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// chags pas 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur ba// 'dod chags nyid kyis rnam grol 'gyur// bzlog pa'i bsgom pa 'di nyid ni// sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes// zhes 'byung ngo*// de'i phyir/ phyi dang nang gi bde ba chen po las khyad par du 'phags pa dang bcas pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa ni/ nges par rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'phral du mngon du byed pa'i phyir/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rmad du byung ba'i thabs kyis phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor mchod pa dang*/

ye shes bsgrub pa la brtson par bya'o// de'i tshul skal ba dang ldan pa dag la/ nye bar phan gdags pa'i phyir brjod par bya ba la bzhi ste/ cho ga'i dbye ba/ cho ga dngos/ de dag gi dgos pa/ de dag la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la/ gang zag gi sgo nas dbye na/ skyes pa kho na 'du na dpa' bo'i ston mo/ bud med kho na 'du na dpa' mo'i ston mo/ zhes bla ma gong ma dag bzhed la/ man ngag snye ma las ni/ 'dir gal te bla ma las gzhan pa rnams la shes rab med pa de'i tshe/ dpa' bo'i ston mor brjod par bya'i tshogs kyi 'khor lor ni ma yin no// bla ma la ni dpa' bo'i ston mo la yang phyag rgya nges par dbul bar bya ste/ bsod nams bsags pa'i ched du'o// zhes gsungs zhing*/ dpa' mo'i ston mo la yang de dang tshul mtshungs par bde mchog stod 'grel las bshad mod/ dam tshig lnga par/ des kyang rang rig ma la 'khyud// mi nus bsam gtan dag gis bya// zhes bshad cing*/ rgyud sde rnams las/ dbang po rab phyag chen/ 'bring ye phyag tha ma las phyag tu gsungs pas/ ye shes kyi phyag rgyar dmigs pas chog gi gzhan du na/ dge slong dang dge tshul bslab pas bcings pa rnams la dpa' bo'i ston mo tsam gyi'ang skal ba med par 'gyur ro// pho mo gnyis ka 'tshogs na tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ste/ ḍom+bi he ru kas/ dpa' bo dang mi ldan pa'i dpa' mo dang*/ dpa' mo dang mi ldan pa'i dpa' bo dag gis/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi bya'o// zhes so// dus kyi sgo nas dbye na/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ rab gnas dang 'brel ba las/ dga' ston nam tsā ru'i bza' ba 'dogs zhes gong ma dag bzhed la/ slob dpon a bha yas ni/ 'o thug cho ga bzhin bsgrubs nas 'gyed pa la tsā ru'i bza' bar bzhed do// rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas dbye na/ kye rdor dang bde mchog la sogs pa lha'i rnal 'byor mi 'dra ba du ma bsgoms nas mchod pa la mdza' ba 'dus pa'i ston mo dang*/

lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang zag dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa ltar 'khod nas/ dkyil 'khor gcig bsgoms nas mchod na/ bdag bskyed gtso bor mchod pa dang*/ mdun du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ram/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la cho ga gcig pas mchod na/ mdun bskyed gtso bor mchod pa zhes bya/ dgos pas dbye na/ rims dang mu ge la sogs pa'i gnod pa bzlog pa'i don du/ rdo rje gur las gsungs pa ltar/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang zag 'dus nas/ lha so so'i sku mdog dang rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pas/ phan tshun dris lan dang*/ dam tshig glur blang ba rnams bya ba ste/ shes par 'dod na/ kho bos byas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gar gyi cho ga bde chen rnam rol las rtogs par bya'o// mchod yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro mchod pa/ rig ldan ma mchod pa dang*/ gzhon nu ma mchod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mi'i bu mo rnal 'byor mar bskyed de mchod pa'am/ de ma 'byor na ro ras la// thod pa dgra s+t+wa mche ba dang*// chu srin rgyal mtshan ral gri dang*// 'phang mdung dung dang mdun du gsung*// zhes sam+bu ṭar bshad pa ltar bris nas de dag la mchod pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bu mo gzhon nu ma grong pa'i chos kyis ma phog pa gcig nas so bdun gyi bar ram/ ma 'byor na cung zad rgan pa 'ga' yang kha bskang du rung bas/ de dag bos nas dbang bskur thob na dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa dang*/ ma thob na khang pa gzhan du spyan drang khrus bya/ ku sha'i gdan la bzhag las thams cad pas bgegs bsrung nas/ slob dpon lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ gzhon nu ma gcig las med na/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ lnga yod na snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi gtso mo dang sngar bskyed pa nas/ so bdun yod na rnal 'byor ma sum cu so bdun du bskyed pa'i bar byas la/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs nas bzhugs par bsam ste/ gzhon nu ma la bstim pa ni ma yin no// de nas de dag la mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang*/ ga bur la sogs pa'i dris lus la byug dpral bar sin+dhū ra dang*/ mig la mig sman bsku/ dbu la me tog dmar po'i phreng ba dang*/ sku la dar dmar po'i na bza' dbul/ sha dang chang la sogs pa'i ston mos tshim par byas nas ltas brtag ste/ dang por gral byas ma thag dang*/ bar du zas la longs spyod pa dang*/ tha ma gyes pa'i dus gsum du/ lus gar byed pa dang*/ ngag sngags dang bkra shis brjod pa/ dge bar lung ston pa sogs byung na shis la/ ngu ba dang*/ phan tshun rtsod pa dang*/ mi dge bar lung ston pa dang*/ bla ma'i mtshang nas 'bru ba sogs mi shis pa'i ltas byung na/ gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa slar yang byed pa'o// gnyis pa cho ga dngos la/ gang zag gnas/ dus/ yo byad/ cho ga de dag gi bslab bya dang drug gi dang po ni/ dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ cho ga'i rim pa mkhas par shes pa rnams dang*/ de nyid bcu shes pa'i rdo rje slob dpon de/ ḍom+bi he ru kas/ de nas dang por tshogs 'dod kyi// tshogs kyi slob dpon dge slong la// rnal 'byor brtson la rtog pa spang*// de nyid bcu shes snying rje che// dam tshig ldan la 'dod chung ngam// yang na de 'dra'i slob dpon la// sems bskyed pa nas snyan gsan dbab// de nas gzhan yang dam tshig ldan// bla ma la gus rtog pa chung*// 'khon gcugs med cing rab dad pas// lha grangs mi la gsol ba gdab// ces pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni kye rdo rjer/ dur khrod ri yi bya skyibs dang*// de bzhin mi med grong khyer dang*// yang na dben pa'am rgya mtsho'i mthar// bza' ba 'di ni rab tu bza'// zhes pa ltar ro// gsum pa ni/ yid btags rgyu ba'i dus nyi shu dgu dang*/ nya dang gnam stong ste zla phyed gnyis dang*/

yar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang*/ yar ngo mar ngo gnyis ka'i brgyad de/ kye rdo rjer/ yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang*// de bzhin du yang brgyad pa nyid// ces gsungs/ ḍom+bi pas ni/ brgyad dang bcu bzhi dang bco lnga gsum po'i yar ngo*/ mar ngo gnyis ka la bshad de/ ci skad du/ mar ngo'i brgyad dang bcu bzhi dang*// bco lnga dag ni rab tu bsngags// de bzhin yar ngo'i brgyad dang ni// bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga la// mkhas pa yis ni 'khor lo bskor// zhes so// bde mchog ltar na/ dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ zla ba so so la bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir mar ngo'i tshes bcu la bshad do// bzhi pa la dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad dang*/ gang zag mchod pa'i yo byad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ nyer spyod lnga dang*/ sha dang chang dang*/ sbrang chang dang bur chang la sogs pa mchod pa'i rdzas ci snyed tshogs pa'o// gnyis pa la/ rnal 'byor pa nus ldan dang*/ rab tu byung ba mchod pa'i rdzas gnyis kyi dang po ni/ ḍom+bi he ru kas/ de la sha dang chang dag dang*// 'bras chen la du khur ba dang*// de bzhin bza' ba bca' ba dang*// btung ba de bzhin bldag dang myang*// 'jig rten pa yi 'byor pa yis// tshogs 'khor 'byor ba'i tshad sta gon// de bzhin spos dang byug pa dang*// dri dang me tog phreng mchog dang*// mar me bdug pa sna tshogs bzhag /ces dang*/ snying po rgyan du/ chang ni dpa' mos ma spyad par// dpa' bo la ni skal med de// sha la de bzhin dpa' bos so// zhes so// gnyis pa ni bu ram dang bu ram gyi lbu ba dang zhun mar la sogs pa so so thar par/ phyi dror gnang ba'i rdzas rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyod kyi/ thabs shes kyi rdzas la longs spyod pa ma yin no// 'o na tshogs 'khor gyi gzhung rnams las/ thabs shes kyis rdzas gnyis la longs spyod par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/

de ni rnal 'byor pa chang 'o mar bsgyur nus pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ dri med 'od las/ gang dag gis sngags kyi stobs kyis sam bsam gtan gyi stobs kyis sbyang ba byas pa dang*/ rtogs pa byas pa dang*/ rab tu 'bar bar byas pa dang bdud rtsir byas pa'i dug rnams ni dug med par 'gyur ba dang*/ chang rnams ni 'o mar 'gyur ba dang dug gi chu la sogs pa'i gdug pa rnams dang sems can rnams la 'chi ba ster bar byed pa la sogs pa rnams ni bcud len du 'gyur ba dang*/ rus pa rnams ni me tog tu 'gyur ba dang*/ so rnams ni mu tig gi 'bras bur 'gyur ba dang*/ thod pa ni pad+mar 'gyur ba dang*/ sha ni pu ṭa ke shar 'gyur ba dang*/ khrag ni sih+lar 'gyur ba dang*/ gci ba ni gla rtsir 'gyur ba dang*/ bshang ba ni bzhi mnyam du 'gyur ba dang*/ ba spu rnams ni gur gum gyi ge sar du 'gyur ba ste/ de ltar gdug pa'i rdzas du ma rnams ni gdug pa'i rang bzhin yongs su gtong ba'i phyir sbyang ba byas pa dang*/ rtog pa byas pa dang rab tu 'bar ba byas pa dang*/ bdud rtsir byas pa rnams ni rang bzhin gyis dag par de bzhin gshegs pas rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad las gsungs pa de ni bden no// dug la sogs pa rang bzhin gyis dag pa bdud rtsir byas pa de rnams rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis zos pa yang lus la stobs chen po rgyas par byed par 'gyur ro// bshang ba la sogs pa rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa rnams lus la byug pa ni mchog gi dri rab tu ldang bar byed pa'o// de'i phyir rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa rnams te gzhan lha dang sngags ma bsgrubs par bklags pa'i rmongs pa mkhas pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa chu skyar gyi sgyur ma 'dzin pa tshogs khang dang gtsug lag khang gi rdzas la mngon par chags pa dang ldan pa yi dwags dang dmyal ba'i skye bar skye ba 'byung ba nges par bcings pa/

rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don nyams pa rgyud las gsungs pa'i don la phyin ci log gi don ston pa po yongs su brtag pa mi byed pa'i skye bo bdud kyi ris chen po rnams kyi bza' ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa rnams su mi 'gyur ro// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// dge slong dang dge tshul chang 'o mar bsgyur ba'i nus pa dang mi ldan pa la ni/ rdzas de dag lce la reg pa tsam ma gtogs longs mi spyad par/ 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras/ thogs med sku mched/ kha che paṇa chen sogs kyang bzhed par/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas tshogs 'khor du bshad la/ dus kyi 'khor lor yang*/ gsung gi rdo rje mchod pa'i don te nges par sngags pa rnams la myos byed gsungs pa nyid ma yin/ zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ chang gi btung ba ni cung zad kha tshim par byed pa ste bum pa la sogs pa bzhin du ma yin te/ myos byed ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang po rnams la thar pa ster bar byed par mi 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung du/ sngags pa chang la sred pa ni// ngu 'bod chen por 'tshed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ thar pa don du gnyer ba'i sgrub pa po rnams kyi phyi rol pa'i mchod sbyin dang tshul mtshungs par sha chang kho na la longs spyod pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dga' ston la tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i ming gdags par mi bya'o// lnga pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po la drug gnas khang brgyan pa/ phyi nang gi yo byad bsham pa/ slob dpon spyan drang ba/ brda dang brda'i lan bya ba/ rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab pa/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyang ba'o// dang po ni gnas dben par skyang nul bya/ bla re la sogs pas brgyan pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de'i dbus su rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ram/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma bzang bar bsham/ slob dpon grogs dang bcas pa la yang*/ rgan rim gyis gdan bshams pa'i mdun du/

rdo rje dril bu dang nang mchod bzhag cing*/ tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par sta gon bya'o// gsum pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes tshogs kyi slob dpon spyan drangs te/ gdan la bzhugs su bcug nas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jig rten las 'das pa mchod pa'i phyir/ tshogs kyi slob dpon mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis dri bzang po'i chu dung phor du blugs la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags brgya rtsa bzlas la slob ma la gtad do// bzhi pa ni/ slob ma dbyug sngon can gyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa dung phor dang ldan pas sgo drung du song nas/ tshogs 'khor la 'du ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la brda dang brda'i lan bya ste/ las kyi rdo rjes lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung bstan nas/ khyed 'ongs sam 'dri/ lan du rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis g.yas pa'i gung mdzub gnyis bstan nas 'ongs so bya/ de bzhin du/ 'dri ba pos g.yon rdo rje khu tshur du byas pa'i gung mdzub gnyis kyi bar du/ mthe bong bcug la bstan nas bde'am bya/ phyag rgya sngar bzhin las bde'o zhes lan bya/ de bzhin du 'dri ba pos srin lag thad sor brkyang ste bstan/ lan du mthe'u chung brkyang*/ 'dri ba pos gung mo gyen du bstan/ lan du mdzub mo thad kar brkyang*/ 'dri ba pos srin lag nam mkhar 'phyar/ lan du lag pas rang gi mgrin pa la reg 'dri ba pos gos gyon pa'i tshul bya/ lan du mthe'u chung mthe bos mnan nas/ sor mo dbus ma gsum gyen du bsgreng*/ 'dri ba pos rang gi nu ma la reg lan du dpral bar reg 'dri ba po sa gzhi la reg lan du sa gzhi la 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa bri ba'i tshul bya/ 'dri ba pos khro gnyer bsdus te bstan/ lan gtsug phud dgrol ba'i tshul bya/ 'dri ba pos dpral bar reg lan du ltag pa bstan/ 'dri ba pos rkang mthil la reg lan du sgang 'phan pa'i stangs bya/

de ltar brda mi shes pa rnams phyir bskrad la/ shes pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ khyod kyi dam tshig la ni khro bo dbyug pa sngon po mdzes// dngos grub phyag na dbyug to rin chen bcings pa 'dzin// dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo 'du bar 'khor sgrol khums// mkha' mdzes rnal 'byor pa yi nang du bdag thongs shig /ces las kyi rdo rje la gsol ba gdab/ des kyang*/ 'di rnams chos la bzang por ltos// zhes sogs brjod cing*/ dung chos kyi chus kha bshal byin la nang du rim gyis btang nas/ rgan rim gyis gral la 'khod du gzhug go /lnga pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes zhu 'bul ba lag len ltar bya'o// drug pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyis rgyud sbyang bar bya'o// dngos gzhi la drug ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pas tshim pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi myang bas tshim pa/ phyi rol gyi 'byung po gtor mas tshim pa/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kha zas kyis tshim pa/ skye mched kyi lha glu gar gyis tshim pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor lhan skyes kyi bde bas tshim pa'o// dang po ni tshogs kyi zhing spyan drangs pa nas bzlas pa'i bar rang rang gi sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub la/ phyi dang nang dang bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams dbul/ gsum pa ni/ so so'i sgrub thabs ltar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams la gtor ma dbul/ bzhi pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog la sogs pa'i nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad rnams mdun du 'du byas la byin brlab zhu/ slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi gtor zhing byin gyis brlabs/ thams cad la bdud rtsi sbrengs/ thams cad kyis phud dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma rnams la phul nas/
