so so'i gtor sngags kyis bsngo/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes/ snod chang gis bkang ba so so'i mdun du bzhag pa la/ phyag dang pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med// bral ze khyi dang gdol pa yang*// rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du zo// zhes brjod la lag pa g.yas pas thod pa bzung*/ g.yon pas mthe'u chung dang mthe bos sha cung zad bzung la/ sor mo dbus ma gsum rtse gsum du bsgreng ba thod pa la bkab la dbul/ len pa pos kyang pad skor dang*/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod cing blang*/ gnyis kas a ho su kha zhes brjod la/ zas rnams rim pa bzhin drang zhing rnal 'byor dang ldan pas tshim par bya'o// lnga pa ni/ kol+la i ri la sogs pa rdo rje'i glu gar yang grub na bya zhing*/ mi shes na ma byas kyang chog go /drug pa ni/ snying gar chang cung zad bskus la mnyes te/ snying gar yi dam yab yum dang*/ spyi bor bla ma rnams gsal btab nas/ snang ba thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor du dran pas bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la blo bzhag go /rjes la drug lhag ma'i gtor ma gtong ba/ bkra shis brjod pa/ lhag chang kha bskang ba/ smon lam gdab pa/ mgron gshegs su gsol ba/ bsngo ba byas te las kyi rjes bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ longs spyad pa'i lhag ma mtha' dag bse dang rin po che'i snod ma yin pa/ shing gzhong la sogs pa'i snod du bsdus pa slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag la/ ma da na cung zad 'thungs te/ lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas pa'i nang nas/ ngag tu bh+rūm̐ zhes pa'am phaiṃ zhes brjod pa dang bstun la/ gtor ma la kha phru btab la yi ge gsum pa dang a kā ro'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun brjod de/

lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams tshim par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas kol+la i re ṭaṭhi la sogs pa rdo rje'i glu dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes sogs brjod do// gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma rnams mtshan mo yin na grib gnon bsrung ba'i phyir dpal 'bar btsugs nas sa gtsang sar dor la btang la/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bya ste/ yi ge brgya pa brjod pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ bzhi pa ni/ rang rang gi gzhung las 'byung ba ltar 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsngo bas rgyas gdab/ lnga pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus te/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa ni gshegs su gsol bar mi bya'o// drug pa ni bdag bskyed bsdus nas/ rang thun mtshams kyi he ru kar mos pas/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas bsrung ba bya'o// drug pa bslab bya ni/ de lta bu'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo de dag la/ rdo rje 'chang gis bcas pa'i bslab bya rnams ches bsrung ba gal che bas/ de dag man ngag snye ma ltar bshad na/ zas la lces mi gdags par mang du bza'/ skom ci snyed pa btung*/ snod stongs par mi bzhag zas sa rjen la mi bzhag tshogs kyi gtso bo la snod gnyis/ gzhan la re re/ bde mchog ltar na thams cad snod gcig tu bza'/ snod mu dang khad chad du mi dgang*/ 'dren pa dang len pa thams cad lag pa gnyis kas drang zhing gnyis kas blang*/ tshogs kyi gtso bo la 'dren pa dang len pa na phyag bya/ 'gro na tshogs kyi gtso bo la phyag byas te zhu/ 'ongs pa na phyag bya/ gzhan yang bya ba zhu ba thams cad phyag byas te zhu/ spyod lam gyi shugs kyis 'gro dgos pa byung na mi dgag brel ba gzhan byung nas 'gro dgos byung na/ mkhyen par gsol bzod par gsol te 'gro/ rtsod pa byed pa byung na gdon/ 'don ma nus na rang gzhan du 'gro/

gtso bos bka' ma bsgos par stan la mi 'dug glu gar dang rol mo dang*/ dris lan dang ma legs par smra bar mi bya/ rkang pa brkyangs te mi 'dug lus ma bsdams par mi 'dug bza' btung dang rnal 'byor pho mo la chags par mi bya/ 'jigs pa dang dogs pa dang ngo tsha ba dang*/ gtsang mi gtsang gi rnam rtog dang bzang mi bzang gi rnam rtog la 'dzem par mi bya/ rnal 'byor pho mo la ma gus pa dang skur ba mi gdab/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs la skrag par mi bya/ zas la skom pa dang chags pa dang 'tshag gi phyir mi bza'/ 'du 'dzi'i gtam dang*/ nyan thos kyi bslab bya dang*/ rigs ngan dang smad 'tshongs ma'i gtam mi bya/ nyon mongs pa'i sems mi bskyed/ las dang po pas kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag ste spyod pa gar yang ma dag pa mi bya/ zas kyis lus ma 'byongs pa dang*/ gtor ma ma thong bar phyir mi 'gro/ ma zhus pa dang bsngo ba smon lam ma byas par mi nyal/ yon bdag gis kyang bza' btung gis tshim par mi 'gyur ba'i mgron spyan mi drang*/ spyan drangs pa rnams zas kyis tshim par bya/ phan tshun rtsod pa dang shags mi bya/ nang du zhugs pa thams cad kyis gsang thub par bya'o// zhes pa ltar dran pa dang shes bzhin ldan pas bag yod pa'i rnal 'byor bya'o// gsum pa dgos pa ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid kyi rgyud la tshogs bsag pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyams chags 'dag pa la sogs pa mtha' yas te/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud du shes par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ phyi rol gyi bris sku la sogs pa lhar dmigs te mchod pas tshogs rdzogs par 'dod na/ rang gi lus kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad rang bzhin gyi lhar gnas pa/ cho gas gsal btab nas mchod na/ tshogs rdzogs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ byams pa seng ge sgra'i mdo las/ gang sangs rgyas mchod pa bas bdag nyid mchod par bya'o// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// dam tshig gi rdzas rnams la'ang lha'i rnal 'byor la skad cig kyang ma yengs par/

dran pa rgyun chags dang ldan pas longs spyad na/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i mchog tu 'gyur te/ dper na/ mkha' lding du 'du shes ma 'khrul bas dug zos kyang nyes pas mi gos la/ bcud len gyi mchog tu 'gyur ba ltar ro// ār+ya de bas kyang*/ nam mkha' lding du bsgoms pa yis// dug rnams thams cad za bar byed// ces te/ mkha' lding bsgoms nas dug za ba la/ mkha' lding gi 'du shes ma 'khrul ba dgos pa ltar/ lhar 'du shes nas tshogs kyi yo byad la longs spyod pa la'ang*/ lha'i nga rgyal las skad cig kyang ma bral bar rgyun chags su nges par dgos pa ni/ gnad kyi don du go bar bya ste/ rgyas par na/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho gar shes par bya'o// zag med bde ba'i rnam rol rdo rje 'chang*// mtha' yas rigs kyi rnam rol lhag pa'i lha// rmad byung phrin las rnam rol srung ma rnams// mnyes byed kun bzang rnam rol 'di bris pas// mtha' yas dge ba bdag gis gang thob des// dpag yas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can rnams// bsam yas rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs nas// bgrang yas yi dam lha rnams mnyes byed shog /ces pa 'di yang rmad du byung ba'i bsod nams la dbang 'byor zhing*/ sde snod dang rgyud sde mtha' yas pa'i thos bsam mthar son nas/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba ngan skyugs ltar gzigs te/ rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la mi lhod pa'i brtul zhugs bzung ba/ nyams dang rtogs pa mtha' yas pa la mnga' 'byor ba'i rnal 'byor pa chen po/ bla ma grags pa rin chen pa'i bka' rgyang ring po nas gnang ba la brten nas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa la bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus par blangs la/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos rnam 'gyur gyi lo snron gyi zla ba'i nyer lnga la dge ldan sa bzang gi dben gnas su sbyar ba dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/

// ༄༅// bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bsod nams rab rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i cho ga bsod nams rab rgyas zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dge legs chos sku'i chu gter las 'ongs bsod nams brgya yi dpal yon can// phun tshogs longs sku'i yid bzhin nor mchog skye dgu'i ci bsam lhun grub ste// rmad byung sprul sku'i rgyal mtshan rtser son phrin las gzi 'od rab 'phros pas// gdul bya'i don sgrub dbang gi rgyal po dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal// rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod pa bas// rje btsun bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod pas// bsod nams phung po khyad par 'phags so zhes// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i phyir// dad pa'i dpal 'bar skal ldan gang zag gis// dngos grub dpal 'bar drin chen chos kyi rje// bkra shis dpal 'bar mchod pa'i yo byad kyis// bsod nams dpal 'bar slad du mchod par rigs// 'dir dngos grub dang yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i tshul/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud rnams las gsungs pa ltar/ nyams su blang bar bya ba la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po ni gnas yid du 'ong bar/ bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog gi rten mdzes shing mtho bar bzhugs su gsol la/ steng du bla re dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ sa gzhi bstar ba spos chus byug pa la/ bla ma brgyud pa re re zhing*/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga mtshan pa bcur re'am/ ma 'byor na re re bsham/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod pa brgya rtsa gcig gam/ ma 'byor na bcu bsham/ gzhan yang yi dam dang*/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bsham ste/ de thams cad kyang rgyu bzang zhing bkod pa mdzes pa/ skye bo gzhan gyis mthong na dad pa skye ba/

rang gis 'byor pa gang yod thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad du phul ba lta bu rgya che zhing grangs mang bar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab cing sngon 'gro bya ba/ mchod pa'i yul spyan drang ba/ de'i spyan sngar mchod cing tshogs bsag pa'o// dang po ni sgrub pa po rnams rten la kha phyogs par 'dug la/ mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs la rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o// de nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa rnams yun ring du bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas kyi tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod do// de ltar spyan drangs pas/ mdun du rin po che'i khri seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa ral pa'i thor cog dang thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod paṇa can/ phyag rgya drug gis spras pa/ sku las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas bdag la dgyes bzhin du bzhugs bar bsam/ de'i mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos rang sangs rgyas 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par bsam mo// gsum pa la tshogs bsag bcu gsum las/

dang po phyag gis mchod pa ni/ rang gi lus bla ma la phul bar bsams la/ dngos su yan lag lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag bya zhing*/ ngag tu/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas// skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur ba// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// gang gis skye dang 'jig pa dag /ring du yongs su spong gyur cing*// sems can kun la thams cad du// phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyud rnams kun gyi don 'dzin cing*// sems can kun la kun stsol pa// kun mchog rdo rje 'chang dbang la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rdzogs sangs rgyas las mngon sum du// khyod kyis chos kun thugs chud pas// mda' 'dzin spyod pa mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// thub pas thub par lung bstan cing*// chos rnams don ston klu sgrub mchog /bde ba can du gshegs pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// nyid kyis de nyid mchog brnyes nas// dman mos sems can don gyi phyir// rngon pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// yi ge'i sbyor ba spangs nas su// brtson pas nya rgyu gsol mdzad de// brtse bas gzhan don mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rgyal po'i bya ba rab spangs nas// sbrul 'tshong rjes su sgrub mdzad de// kañtsi'i grong du grub pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// ye shes mkha' 'gros rjes gnang zhing*// gzhan don spyod pas don gsum mdzad// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dam pa'i de nyid don rtogs te// brtse bas rus sbal zhabs ldan pas// sems can smin par mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// khyod ni brtson pas grub brnyes te// 'bar bas 'bar ba'i spyod 'dzin cing*// kun la phan par mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// nus pa la ni mnga' brnyes shing*// spyod pa kun gyis rmad byung bas// 'jig rten 'dren par mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gu h+ya pa// brtse bas log 'dren rnal 'byor ma// btul nas 'gro ba skyong ba la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// mi mthun phyogs rnams rab spangs te// dkar po rnam par 'phel mdzad pa// rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs pad la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// grub nas grub pa'i lam ston cing*// grol nas rnal 'byor phan mdzad pa// bar ma'i slob dpon dam pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// til brdungs pas ni rab grub pas// skal ldan gzhan la brtse ba can// mu stegs rnam par sun 'byin la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bram ze las ni rab byung zhing*// gnas lnga la ni rab sbyangs pa// dka' bas dam pa sten pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// shes bya la ni rab mkhas shing*// nus pa kun la thogs med pa// pha na phing gur grags pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// skad gnyis smra ba'i mchog gyur cing*// shes rab ldan pas phan mdzad pa// brtsegs pa'i mtha' dang ldan pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// brtson pas dka' ba cher mdzad de// rgyud kun 'dren mdzad skad gnyis smra// rje btsun blo gros grags pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum du// khyod la byin gyis brlabs pa yis// shes bya kun la thogs med ldan// rgyud kun gyi ni bdag por gyur// kun dga' snying por grags pa yi// dpal ldan sa skyar bzhugs gyur cing*// bde ba can du gshegs pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gang gi sras kyi thu bo pa// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin rlabs pas// gnas lnga la ni rab mkhas shing*// bsod nams ye shes rtser gyur pa// nyid kyis gzhan don rdzogs mdzad nas// 'jig rten rnams ni gzhugs pa'i phyir// bde ba can du gshegs pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// khyed kyi thugs ni 'jam dbyangs ltar// shes bya kun la ma rmongs shing*// 'jig rten kun gyi rtsa lag tu// dgongs pa khyed kyi grags pa yis// rgyal mtshan dri ma med pa thob// ngo mtshar du ma'i spyod pa 'dzin// kun nas yon tan ldan khyod la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// brtse bas sems can thams cad la// dpal 'byor chen po'i 'od zer gyis// rtag tu skyong bar mdzad khyod la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'gro kun dga' mdzad yon tan rgyal mtshan 'dzin// chos kyi dpal gyis srid pa gsum na gsal// rmad du byung ba'i phrin las bzang po can// mtshungs med chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo// blo gros chen po bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// chos kyi dpal gyis mtha' yas 'gro rnams la// phan bde bzang po 'bad med stsol mdzad pa'i// chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma gus pas bsten// zab mo'i lam gyi rmad byung yon tan brnyes// snyan brgyud bdud rtsis gdul bya tshim mdzad dpal// zhang ston chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs pa'i dpal// gsung ngag rin chen gter gyi mdzod bzung nas// dad ldan sku bzhi'i dpal la 'god mdzad pa// rgyal ba brag phug pa la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu gting dpag dka' ba'i blo gros kyis// phyi nang rten 'brel zab mo thugs su chud// gzung 'dzin rtog pas mi g.yo ting 'dzin brtan// mtshungs med ri khrod pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can// tshul khrims dam tshig tshogs rnams srog bzhin bsrungs// 'gro kun brtse bas bu gcig lta bur gzigs// 'dren mchog 'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pas// nor bu rin chen rgyal mtshan rtser son ltar// dpal 'byor bzang po'i 'bras stsol chos kyi rje// thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bla ma rnams la phyag bya zhing*/

chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyi khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag med dbang phyug sku dang gnyis med cing*// bde chen 'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// rgyal ba sras bcas la sogs sprin 'phro ma// rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku// 'khor ba stongs par mdzad pa'i thugs rje yis// gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la 'god mdzad pa// rig lnga bde bar gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha' lta bur thams cad thogs med cing*// 'dod dgu bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul lus dang ldan// thugs dam dbang gis sgrub la brtser dgongs pa// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku brnyes te// srid pa'i 'khor lo ma lus gcod pa'i phyir// thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa// rgyal nyid rdo rje'i zhabs kyi pad la 'dud// ces yi dam la phyag bya'o// gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ sngar bshams shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams/ bzang zhing rgya che bar bsams la/ ngag tu/ stong gsum 'di dang stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra satwa gu ru pa de bh+yaḥ sarba satwa u pa ka ra ṇa ya ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon 'bul/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad rkang pa tha ma gnyis dang*/ gong ma sngar bzhin las/ rkang pa gnyis pa'i mchod yon gyi tshab tu/ zhabs bsil dang*/ sngar gyi ar+ghaṃ gyi tshab tu/ pā d+yaṃ bcug pas zhal bsil 'bul/ de bzhin du me tog dang*/ puṣ+paṃ/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū paṃ/ mar me dang*/ dī paṃ/ dri mchog dang*/ gan+dhaṃ/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ye/

sil snyan dang*/ shab+da sogs 'don pa bsgyur la 'bul zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o// de nas gos sna tshogs pa 'bul zhing*/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde// srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi// na bza'i mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul// bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra ba sa s+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ yang rang gi snying ga nas rig ma bcu drug dpag tu spros la/ de rnams kyis bla ma dkon mchog mchod par bsam zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya rnams bcas la/ dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi wang ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes pa// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma pi wang sgra yis mchod// oṃ badz+ra wī ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ de bzhin du rkang pa bar pa gnyis thams cad la 'dra bar sbyar la/ gser bzang mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma gling bu'i sgra yis=// oṃ badz+ra waṃ se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rdza rnga ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod// oṃ badz+ra mṛ daṃ ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga zlum ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma rnga zlum sgra yis= /oṃ badz+ra murdzi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ li khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma bzhad pa'i bde bas= /oṃ badz+ra ha s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg mo ni// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma sgeg mdzes bde bas= /oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma// sna tshogs dar dang rgyan gyis=

/nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma snyan pa'i glu yis= /oṃ badz+ra gī tī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pri yang ku mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma mdzes pa'i gar gyis= /oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma me tog sil mas= /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ in+d+ra nī la'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma bdug spos sprin gyis= /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi ma'i mdog can rdo rje mar me ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma mar me'i phreng bas= /oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sin+dhū'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab= /dpal ldan bla ma dri bzang byug pas= /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma gzugs kyi bde bas mchod// oṃ rū pa badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ btsod kyi mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /dpal ldan bla ma ro yi bde bas=// oṃ ra sa badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis= /nam mkha' gang bar sems gyis= /dpal ldan bla ma reg bya'i bde bas= /oṃ spar+ṣe badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma chos khams bde bas mchod// oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces brjod do// de nas phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga las bshad pa ltar/ rin chen sna bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lngas kyang mchod la/ rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser// dkar dang nag dang ser skya dang*// de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang*// me tog phreng ba du ma dang*// bla re dag dang bcas pa yis// 'phan dang yol bas shin tu mdzes// de bzhin bza' bca' du ma yis// rab mnyam gzhag pas bla ma mchod// dril dpyangs me tog spos kyis brgyan// shin tu snyan pa'i dril bu 'khrol// snyan pa'i rnga yi sgra sgrogs shing*// bzhad pa'i sgra yis bla ma mchod// gser dngul brgya stong du ma dang*// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang*// glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang*// rna rgyan dang ni gdu bu'am// mgul gdub sor gdub dam pa dang*// gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs// chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid// bran pho bran mo sring mo rnams// bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'bul// zhes brjod do// de nas nang mchod rgyas par 'bul ba'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ bar ma dbugs dbyung mchog dag dang*// dri yi chu dang bcas pa yi// zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ches// he ru ka dpal bla ma mchod// oṃ sarba badz+ra kā mi ni/ sarba bhak+ṣa sho dha ya/ gu h+ya badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas bla na med pa'i mchod pa sgrub thabs nas bshad pa ltar byas la/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ lha mi'i longs spyod phun tshogs thams cad dang*// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po dang*// gsang dang rab gsang gsang chen bla med kyis// mchod pa'i sprin chen rgya mtsho dag gis mchod// ces brjod cing ci nus pa'i mchod pa dbul bar bya'o// de nas sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rangs ba/ skyabs su 'gro zhing lus dbul ba/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa/

dge ba bsngo ba/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa bzung zhing lam ston pa rnams rgyun bshags nas 'byung ba ltar bya ste/ bdag gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang*// chags dang zhe sdang rnam par rmongs sems kyis// srid pa nyam ngar sdig pa ci bgyis pa// de rnams bsdams te thams cad so sor bshags// rdzogs sangs rgyas mgon byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa gzhan gyi dge ba gang bgyis pa// de'ang bla med byang chub 'bras thob par// ma lus pa la rtag tu rjes yi rangs// rdzogs sangs rin chen rang gi sems gnas dang*// rtog pa'i drwa ba rab dral dam pa'i chos// sa dbang tshogs dang brtul zhugs dbang dge 'dun// rab tu dad pas rtag tu skyabs su mchi// rgyal dang bdag nyid legs skyes de dag la// kun nas kun tu bdag gis lus 'di 'bul// sems dpa' mchog gis bdag nyid yongs bzhes la// dad pas khyed la 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// glo bur nyon mongs tshad pas gdungs pa yi// bskyed pa'i skye bo mtha' dag grol ba'i phyir// dam chos bdud rtsi'i chos rnams bshad pa ru// sman mchog mgon po la ni bdag bskul lo// mchog tu mi dge la sogs rab bcom pa'i// bdud rtsi skye rga na dang 'chi ba las// mya ngan 'da' bzhed gyur pa spangs nas ni// sman mchog mgon po la ni bdag gsol 'debs// lus ngag yid kyis bsod nams ni// bgyis sam bgyid du stsal ba'am// rjes su yi rang gang ci'ang rung*// des ni 'jig rten kun mkhyen shog /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub du ni sems bskyed ltar// de ring nyid du sems bskyed do// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// de bzhin brtan por gzung bar bgyi// ji ltar phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis// sngon gyi bde gshegs grangs med la// thugs bskyed dam tshig dpag med dag

/'tshang rgya'i bar mi btang ba ltar// bdag ni deng nas byang chub bar// lus srog ltos pa med par yang*// bslab 'di mig bzhin bsrung la gnas// ye shes thugs kyis dgongs su gsol// rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur lnga// rtag tu bsten cing spyad par bgyi// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi btang ngo*// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dag /rtag tu mi phyed brtul zhugs bzung*// rgyal bas dgongs te gsungs pa yis// dam tshig bzhi po bsrung bar bgyi// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi sogs// rig sngags 'chang kun mi 'da' ltar// deng nas bla med byang chub bar// bdag gis tshul bzhin bsrung bar bgyi// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum bzla// zla re bcu phrag gnyis pa dang*// bco lnga la ni rab tu mchod// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// 'khor ba dag kyang mi spong zhing*// mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la// gus pas bsnyen bkur mchod par bya// bdag gis sems can thams cad la// brnyas pa nyid du mi bya'o// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o// zhes brjod pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na dha ri ka pa'i sgrub thabs nas bshad pa ltar ram/ bla ma rje btsun chen pos lo hi pa'i sgrub thabs su gsungs pa ltar/ tshig lhug pa rnams brjod pas kyang don grub pa nyid do// de nas yid gyis rtse gcig tu smon pa'i gnas 'di dag myur du 'grub par gyur cig snyam du bsams la/ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pa// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// blo ldan rigs bzang nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che ldan bla ma la dad cing*// 'khor lo bde mchog dam tshig la gnas shog

/rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang*// zab cing rgya che'i chos ni rtogs pa dang*// ka ko si la la sogs rtag bza' zhing*// mthar thug bde chen bsgrub pa'i skal ldan shog /deng nas byang chub snying po mchis bar du// bcom ldan bde gshegs kun tu bzang po dang*// gsang ba'i theg pa dbyer med rmad byung ni// mi 'bral tshul bzhin rtag tu bsgrub par shog /sgrub mchog 'di la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// tshe 'di la sogs skye ba bdun bar du// bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor lo chen po yi// zhabs rdul ze'u 'bru spyi gtsug gnas par shog /gang tshe 'gro ba'i mgon la lta ba'am// phyir zhing cung zad 'dri bar 'don na yang*// bcom ldan bde mchog thugs kyi bdag po ni// thams cad sgrib med sa ler mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi// sems can ma lus byang chub dgod pa'i phyir// thub pa'i dbang po'i spyod pa ci lta bar// bdag gi spyod pa'ang de dang 'dra bar shog /sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin// bdag gi bde bas de kun bde bar shog /tshe rabs kun tu sgo gsum rin chen dang*// bum bzang dpag bsam shing sogs lta bur shog /mgon po kun mkhyen thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang*// sgrub pa mchog la rtse gcig sbyangs pa yi// bder gshegs mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub mchog thob nas// sems can thams cad smin pa'i mthu ldan shog /dbang dang mngon shes so sor rig pa dang*// gzungs dang rnam par thar pa'i sgo thob nas// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// gnas dang nye gnas la sogs 'god par shog /ting 'dzin mang pos gdul bya'i rgyud mkhyen nas// thams cad 'dun gnas sngags kyi gzungs kyis ni// sna tshogs nam mkha' khyab pa'i chos bstan nas// zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs 'god par shog /bder gshegs spyan sngar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yis// dam bcas bsrung zhing dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// thugs dam bzhin du rtag bsrung dngos grub ni// rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la stsol bar shog

/'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog rgyal mtshan gdugs tshogs thogs nas kyang*// rol mo'i sgra dang glu snyan tshogs mchod nas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su phyin par shog /skad cig de la snang ba gsum thob nas// gsal dang rtags snang rang gi rig thob nas// dur khrod la sogs rgyal gnyis sa thob ste// tshan+do la sogs sa la 'god par shog /shin tu rnam par dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas rnam par grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag po ru// sras kyi bdag po nyid du bdag gyur cig /sa gsum mthar phyin gsum phrag gsum gnas shog /shes brgyad gyur pa ye shes lngar gyur te// ye shes chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i// chos sku byang chub snying po thob par shog /chos dbyings las byung nam mkha'i mtshan nyid 'dra// thog ma dang ni tha ma med pa'i bdag /sems dpa' rdo rje thugs kyi bdag po ru// rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du bdag gyur cig /dngos grub ma lus pa ni kun gyi gnas// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lhar gyur pa// sdug pos brgyan gyur ma lus kun gyi rgyan// mi 'gyur dam pa nyid du bdag gyur cig /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku brnyes pa// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes su rab chags pas// 'dod chags me kun rang bzhin rnam dag pa// gsung gi dbang phyug nyid du bdag gyur cig /nga rgyal gnas dag mnyam nyid lhun gyis grub// yon tan yid bzhin rgya che mkha' 'dra ba// gdul bya rdzogs sangs nyid du re skong ba// rdo rje nyi ma nyid du bdag gyur cig /phrag dog dag pas bya ba grub brnyes shing*// phrin las rgya mtsho gdul bya dpag med rnams// sgrub mchog phyag rgya che la 'god mdzad pa// bder gshegs gdon mi za bar bdag gyur cig /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /dpal ldan bde gshegs 'khor lo'i sku ru grub// nam mkha' dag dang mnyam pa'i mthu stobs kyis// 'khor 'das ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal du shog

/ces zhe thag pa nas smon lam gdab bo// bcu gnyis pa gnang ba nod pa ni/ bla ma la sogs pa tshogs zhing de dag gi zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi gnas pa 'di legs par gnas pa yin gyi/ gnas pa 'dis gnas na mchog 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs par bsam mo// bcu gsum pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ gong du bshad pa'i sngags kyis chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pa phul nas/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba drag tu gdab cing*/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs la/ so so skye bor gyur gang dang*// rnal 'byor ma thob dbang gis dang*// nye bar mkho ba med pa dang*// brjed dang shes bzhin ma yin pas// cung zad cho ga nyer ma tshang*// de dag bkru zhing bzod mdzad rigs// cho ga'i bya ba ma tshang ba// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang*// de sras rnams dang tshangs la sogs// 'jig rten skyong rnams bzod par mdzod// ces pas cho ga'i nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas/ tshogs rten 'khor bcas rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol bar bsam mo// gsum pa ni/ de ltar tshogs bsags bcu gsum nyams su blangs pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo bar bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bla ma mchog la dbang nod nas// yang dag lam gyis grol gyur te// rdo rje 'dzin par 'jug gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// des ni sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bsod nams 'dis ni yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang*// gtso bo dbang bskur sku yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab par grags pa yis// rdo rje rol par lhan cig srid gsum de yi go 'phang 'thob par shog /bsod nams kyis ni 'gro ba rnams la ni// yun ring 'jigs pa med pa dga' ba dang*// bdag gzhan bde ba mchog ni skyed gyur cig

/de nyid gsal byed rmongs pa rab 'dzoms shing*// mchog tu mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur shog /bde ba phun tshogs yang dag ldan// nad med dge ba'i sems dang ni// 'dod dang thar sogs yang dag thob// phun sum tshogs pa 'grub gyur cig /sbyin pa la sogs rnams kyi 'gro ba'i yid la re ba yang dag rdzogs pa'i mchog /rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer thams cad bcom zhing he ru ka sogs mkha' 'gro mas// 'khor lo yongs bskor rgyal ba bla ma ye shes 'byung gnas thar pa ster ba gang*// 'di dang shin tu brtse ba che ldan 'phags dpal 'byor ba'i myur bar rtag tu shog /zhes sogs ci ltar rigs pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ bkra shis brjod nas mchod rdzas dman pa rnams bsdus la/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor zhing*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// tshul 'di la rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na/ rdo rje 'chang gis skye ba 'di la mngon du byed cing*/ dngos grub gzhan thams cad zhar la grub pa nyid do// rmad byung yon tan kun gyi gzhi gcig pu// dngos grub rtsa ba dpal ldan bla ma nyid// bsam sbyor dag pas bsten cing gus mchod na// 'phral dang yun gyi dge legs kun 'byung zhes// lung las gsung zhing tshad mar grub pas na// bdag nyid legs par 'dod pa'i skye bo dag /lus dang longs spyod bdog pa'i dngos kun dang*// srog gi bar gyi bla ma bsten pa gces// de phyir bdag kyang tshul 'dir 'bad 'dod nas// bdag nyid chen po bla ma mchod pa'i tshul// dri med rgyud dang gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar// 'khrul med go sla'i ngag gis gsal bar bshad// 'di sbyar dge ba dal 'gro'i rgyun bzang des// kun mkhyen bsod nams rgya mtsho cher zhugs nas// dpal 'byor yid bzhin nor bus 'gro kun gyi// chos dang bsod nams rgyas par byed gyur cig

/dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud rnams las gsungs pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po nā ro ta pa'i man ngag bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bsod nams rab rgyas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus pas blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos khro mo'i lo dbo zla ba'i tshes gcig la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sde snod 'dzin pa shākya'i rgyal mtshan no// i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu/ 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// bde mchog 'khor lo'i pho brang gi rnam bshad bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ thabs shes gnyis med bde ba che// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa la// btud de de yi dkyil 'khor gyi// tshad dang rnam bzhag gsal bar bri// 'dir rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa rje btsun rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs las/ de la 'khor lo'i bzhi'i sa gzhi ni sngon po yin la/ sa gzhi'i steng nas rtsibs kyi ngo bo cung zad tsam 'phag pa yin la/ 'khor lo so so'i mtho dman gyi khyad par ni/ lha rnams rang gi pus mo'i tshad tsam res 'phag pa yin la/ rdo rje la sogs pa rwa ba'i dpangs ni/ lha de dag gi sku'i rked pa tsam slebs pa yin cing*/ ka ba'i dpangs ni dbu'i steng nas yar khru gang tsam gyi 'phag pa'i tshad yin la/ steng gi phub kyis ni 'og ma'i phub non pa ste/ blo'i snang ba la char gyi chu lta bur yang gcig gi steng du gcig gi chu babs nas/ dam tshig 'khor lo'i phub kyi 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i thad so non pa tsam ste/ chu yang 'dod yon gyi phyi sor 'gro ba lta bu'o// dam tshig gi 'khor lo ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la phebs pa ste/ kha dog ni shar sngo ba/

lho ser ba/ nub dmar ba/ byang ljang ba'o// zhes gsungs la/ de'i don bshad na/ de la gzhal yas khang cha chen bcu drug du byas la/ tshangs thig nas bgrangs pa'i cha chen lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis btab pa'i nang ma la rtsig pa rim pa lnga dpangs su cha chen bzhi/ pha gu cha phran gcig drwa ba'i sa cha phran gnyis/ gser gyi ska rags cha phran gcig gi lnga cha dang bcas pa'o// sgo'i nang du dam tshig 'khor lo'am/ lha snam phyogs re re nas cha chen re re pa/ dpangs cha phran gcig pa/ de'i steng du 'khor lo bzhi'i stegs bu'am/ sa gzhi ni gru bzhi pa/ rgyar cha chen drug pa/ dpangs su cha chen gsum dang*/ cha phran cig dang cha phran gcig gi lnga cha yin la/ kha dog ni sngon po ste/ in+d+ra nī la'i sa gzhi la// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid bsam// zhes pas so// gal te de ni phyogs mdog gi dbus sngon por 'dri ba'i lung yin gyi/ stegs bu'i shes byed ma yin no snyam na/ lung des phyogs mdog gi dbus sngon por bri ba bstan na/ shar sngon por yod pas dbus dkar por rigs pa la de ltar ma bstan pas so// gal te stegs bu bri bya'i skabs su 'chad pa mi rigs so zhe na skyon med de// rig pa mchog gi rgyud las dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lag na rdo rje gnas pa'i stegs bu byas la/ zhes bri bya'i skabs nas stegs bu bshad pa'i phyir ro// stegs bu de'i steng du phyogs bzhi nas cha phran phyed phyed dor ba'i dbus su/ 'khor lo so so'i sa gzhi'am stegs bu zlum po de dag gi steng nas yar 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi ngo bo cung zad de/ nas re tsam 'phag pa yin la/ sku gsung thugs dang bde chen 'khor lo rnams kyi so so'i mtho dman gyi khyad par ni/ lha rnams rang rang gi pus mo'i tshad tsam re/ lha'i sku tshad cha chen gcig la/ pus mo man chad lus kyi bzhi cha yin pas na/ stegs bu las cha phran gcig gi sku 'khor mtho ba nas rim pa bzhin cha phran res 'phag pa yin la/

rdo rje la sogs pa pad+ma 'khor lo gri gug rnams kyi rwa ba'i dpangs ni lha de dag gi sku'i rked pa tsam slebs pa der cha phran gnyis yin zhing*/ 'khor lo gsum bde chen 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i ka ba'i dpangs ni lha rang rang gi dbu'i steng nas yar khru gang tsam re cha phran gcig gis 'phag pa'i tshad yin la/ ka ba'i steng du gdung cha phran phyed phyed dang*/ thog gi dpangs la cha phran phyed phyed kyis 'phag pa/ 'khor lo gong ma gong ma'i ka ba so so'i gsham nas gyen du cha chen re res 'phag pa'i sar/ 'khor lo 'og ma 'og ma'i khyams 'degs pa'i bar bkags dang bcas pa bde chen 'khor lo'i ka ba brgyad kyi steng du gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su phub pa'i phyogs mtshams kyi re mig brgyad legs par phub nas/ re mig dbus ma'i steng du rin po che'i rtsig pa cha phran gsum dang cha phran gcig gi lnga cha/ pha gu cha phran sum cha/ drwa ba'i sa la cha phran sum gnyis/ de'i steng mnyam par phub pa'i rtse mor tog gis spras te/ bde chen 'khor lo'i steng gi phub kyi 'og ma bde chen 'khor lo'i phub non la/ de bzhin du thugs 'khor gyi gsung*/ gsung gi sku/ skus dam tshig gi 'khor lo non pa ste/ blo'i snang ba la/ khang pa gong ma'i char gyi chu khang pa 'og ma'i thog tu 'bab pa lta bu/ 'khor lo bzhi po yang gcig gi steng du gcig gi chu babs nas dam tshig 'khor lo'i khyams phyi ma gser gyi ske rags dang*/ nang ma sku 'khor gyi bar bkab pa la brten nas phub pa'i 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i sa stegs non pa tsam ste/ chu yang 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i rgyar cha phran gnyis pa/ dpangs su cha phran gcig pa'i phyi sor 'gro ba lta bu'o// dam tshig 'khor lo ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la phebs pa ste/ kha dog ni 'dir rgyas 'debs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mdog gi dbang du byas nas/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pas rgyas 'debs pas sngo ba/

de bzhin du lho ser ba/ nub dmar ba/ byang ljang ba/ dbus su rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang gis rgyas 'debs pas na dkar po'o// gzhal yas khang gi tog gi rtsa ba nas 'dod yon gyi bar dang*/ shar gyi rtsig pa nas nub kyi rtsig pa'i bar mnyam po yin te/ lus gru bzhi mnyam pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// rtsig pa'i dpangs ni rgya dpangs mnyam po dang*/ rgya phyed dpangs la sogs pa bzhed pa mang yang 'dir nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa'i gsang ba dam pa'i gsang ba'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po las/ sa phyogs der ni rin po che sna bdun gyis khang pa brtsegs ma/ gru bzhi pa/ ka ba bzhi zug pa/ sgo bzhi btod pa/ mnyam pa/ nyams dga' ba/ shin tu rnam par phye ba/ ches mdzes par byas pa/ bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/ 'od 'bar ba/ them skas bzhi dang ldan pa/ 'phang du dpag tshad gsum yod pa/ rgyar dpag tshad lnga yod pa zhig byung ngo*// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa ste rgyas par logs su shes so// bde mchog 'khor lo'i pho brang gi /rnam bshad zhib mor phye ba'i tshul// kun mkhyen gnyis pa bu ston sogs// bod yul sngon byon mkhas rnams kyis// gsal bar bshad pa ma mthong nas// rje btsun bla ma'i dgongs pa ltar// dge slong kun dga' bzang pos bris// dge bas rdo rje 'dzin thob shog/ // ༄༅// mkha' spyod kyi man ngag ril bu la brten nas sgrub pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na maḥshrī tsakra saṃ bha rā ya/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi man ngag rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug nā ro ta pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub bsgrub par 'dod na/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las la sbyar dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ mngal skyes sam sgong skyes gang rung bsgoms nas yab kyi yi ge bdun pa la bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi'am/ mi grub kha med du 'bum phrag bdun bzla'o// gnyis pa ni/ de nas dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i rkang mthil gyi pags pa skam po dang*/

dpa' bo de nyid kyi khrag cha gcig lig pu mig ste zangs gling la sogs pa'i gling gzhan nas 'byung ba'i rdo'i bye brag yin te cha gcig dmar chos rgyal gling mtha'i rdo bas rung gsung*/ sdong ros dang*/ gi wang dang*/ kha che gur gum gsum/ zho cha la cha mnyam pa/ dpa' bo'i khrag bsres pa cha gcig bla ma dmar dpa' bo'i snying khrag dgos gsung*/ rdzas lnga po de la ril bu sran ma 'bring po tsam byas la grib ma la bskams te/ de gser ma sha ka gsum dang ra ti lnga la byas pa'i ga 'ur bcug de dngul ma sha ka gsum dang ra ti bdun la byas pa'i ga 'ur bcug de zangs ma sha ka bzhi dang ra ti gsum las byas pa'i ga 'ur bcug de grog gam/ shog bu'am/ dar ram/ ras la gi wang dang gur gum bsres pas/ yi ge bdun pa'i 'khrul 'khor bris la rab gnas byas pas dril nas/ thod pa mtshan ldan nam rin po che'i za ma tog gi nang du bcug la bzhag go /de nas mtshams dam por byas la thun bzhi'i nges pas bdag bskyed mngal sgong gang rung bsgom mo// mdun du ril bu'i snod bzhag la/ sum+bha dang nang mchod gtor bas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdzas kyi ril bu mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs nas ril bu la thim par bsams la/ snod la gzungs thag btags pa bzung nas yi ge bdun pa bzlas so// 'di la grangs kyi nges pa mi dgos/ ril bu dro ba'am du ba 'thul ba'am 'od 'bar ba'i rtags gsum gang rung ma byung gi bar du bya'o// gsum pa ni/ dur khrod dam rang gnas su yang rung ste/ bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyis bris la/ mi 'gags nas shi ba'i ro bdud rtsi lngas bkrus ste rdul tshon gyi shar sgor bzhag la ril bu de'i zhal du gzhug

rang stan bde ba la bsdad nas yi dam lha'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer spros te ro'i snying gar phyin pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ grub par bsam/ hūm̐ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs te hūm̐ de la zhugs pas yab gyi yi ge bdun pa'i sngags su gyur par bsam/ sngags dang hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las dpal he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur par bsams nas/ sngags bzlas shing thun mtshams su mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa la gtor ma 'bul zhing thun bzhir bsgrub pa byas pas ro de'i sngags kyi ril bu phyir phul byung ba blang ste/ ga'u dang bcas pa rang gi khar bcug nas/ mkha' spyod dang bde ba can sogs gang du 'gro bar 'dod pa'i gnas yid la byas na the tshom med de/ sin+dhū ra yi byung khungs rgyu// pa ti'i 'og tu nyin bcug na// nam mkhar thig le snang bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ tsakra saṃ bha ra yi sku// tsa turmu kha'am e ka pa// gang rung mu khar ku li ka /bcug nas sngar bzhin bsgrub byas na// de yis sngar bzhin ster bar 'gyur// zhes so// de ltar dngos su ma byung na/ dro ba dang 'bar ba sogs kyi rtags byung ba/ de'i tshe skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i dus su blangs nas rang gi khar bcug na sngar bzhin du 'gyur ro// yi ge bdun pa'i 'khrul 'khor bri na pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa bri/ de'i mthar mu khyud gnyis byas pa'i dang po la ā li/ gnyis pa la kā li/ de'i mthar rdo rwa me ri bri/ lte ba la hūm̐ dang*/ 'dab ma drug la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa rnams mgo phyir bstan la bri/ rab gnas ni mdun gyi 'khor lo de stong par bsgoms la/ stong pa'i ngang las 'khor lo'i lte ba la bkod pa'i yi ge las 'khor lo bris pa bzhin bskyed la/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon dang*/ 'khor lo'i yi ge rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te dam tshig gi 'khor lo la bstims la/

mchod pa lnga dang bstod pa byas nas 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags thams cad rim pa bzhin du brgya brgya bzlas pas rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro// man ngag 'di la zhal shes gnyis yod do// dpal nā ro pa'i zhal gdams rje btsun mal dang*/ rje pu hrangs lo chung gi man ngag rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun sa skya pa'i man ngag ltar bris pa'o// bde mchog gi sgrub pa mi byed pa la dpe 'di mi ston pa dang*/ nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas tshogs kyi mchod pa gser yon dang bcas pa mi byed na man ngag zab mo mi sbyin pa rgyas btab bo// //gu h+ya// // ༄༅// rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /swa sti/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus de nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i phyir du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom mo// rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog dmar po ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma de rang la thim pas rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i steng du baṃ yig dmar po/ de'i mtha' mar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/

badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa'i 'od kyis lus thams cad gang bas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg sbyangs nas lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du 'phyang ba/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ste/ zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbur brgyan pa/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la/ lte bar oṃ baṃ/

go cha rnams yig 'bru las byung ba lhar bskyed pa yod na'ang*/ 'dir nā ro pas yi ge nyid lha'i ngo bor bzhed de/ a bhi dhā nar/ lha nyid gsang sngags tshul gyis ni// dngos grub thams cad ster bar byed// ces so// dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yam̐ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ maṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ dmar mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ thugs ka'i baṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ 'dir mchod pa ma byas kyang mi 'gal te/ grub chen lū hi pas/ ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs nas/ dam tshig 'khor lo la myur gzhug zhes pa'i 'grel par/ lā ba pas/ myur du ces pa ni mchod pa la ma ltos par ro// zhes gsungs so// spyan drangs pa'i lha dzaḥspyi bor bkug hūm̐ gis bstim/ baṃ gyis dbyer med du 'dres/ hoḥ'adres pa las byung ba'i bde ba la sems gtad do// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ rdzogs rim ni/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung dmar seng nge ba cig gi nang du dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du bskor ba la sems gtad pas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye zhing*/ smin mtshams kyi thad du dga' ba 'khyil pa la sems gtad pas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o// bzlas pa ni/ sngar gyi snying ga'i baṃ yig sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin rlabs dang yon tan rnams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas/ bdag gi sdig sgrib dag cing yon tan rgyas par bsams la ci nus bzlas/ yid bzlas ni/

rlung kha sbyar la sngar ltar yid kyis lan bdun bzla'o// de nas gtor ma mi 'bul na dge rtsa bsngos la/ rang rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis bya ba gzhan la 'jug go /thun rjes sam gnas skabs gzhan du gtor ma btang na/ sha chang gis sbags pa'i gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho/ bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa rdo rje mkha' 'gror sgyed bu ma bshad pas nā ro pa rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa sgyed bu mi bzhed/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa gsum dang*/ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ne wi te pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod bdud rtsis mchod la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug pa// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la/

'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dngos 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang*/ 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas kyang*// rol mo sil snyan sgra snyan sogs mchod nas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid par shog /ces pas bsngo ba bya/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ gnas skabs thams cad du rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// ༈ //na maḥshrī gu ra we/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub thob nā ro ta pa pham mthing pa// shes rab brtsegs dang mal jo sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje brag phug pa// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bskyed rim zab mo'i mkha' spyod rnal 'byor dang*// rdzogs rim dbu ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i mthus// bde chen lhan skyes ye shes skye ba dang*// mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// nā ro pa'i man ngag gi snyan brgyud la gsol ba 'debs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs cho ga dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang bcas pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gsal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang*// 'od gsal rnam pa kun ldan stong pa nyid// dbyer med zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes sku// lhan skyes bde ba'i mchog la gus btud nas// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi nges pa'i don// grub brnyes lu hi'i bzhed pa bla na med// rdzogs rim zab mo'i ye shes sgrub pa'i thabs// rgyud 'grel gdams pa ji bzhin bshad kyis nyon// 'dir kha che'i paṇ+ḍi chen po shākya shrī bha dra'i man ngag

bde mchog dkar po la brten nas byang chub sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/ 'khor lo bde mchog lo hi pa'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten pa cung zad thob cing*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ dur khrod la sogs pa dben pa'i gnas su/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa byas nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad 'od gsal bar bsgom mo// de ltar stong par bsams pa'i ngang las/ skad cig gi sa 'og gi mthar thug par ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i rgyar/ gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi dang*/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng bas mtshams bcings pa dang*/ sa 'og nas sa steng gi bar du shin tu mtho ba mthug cing mkhregs pa sra zhing 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ rdo rje'i rwa ba'i steng du bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur cing*/ steng rdo rje'i mda'i drwa ba dang*/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ steng rdo rje'i bla res brgyan pa'i rdo rje'i gur 'bar ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin/ nges don gyi he ru kar bsams la/ shrī he ru ka a haṃ/ zhes brjod de de'i ngang las skad cig gis 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i steng du/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhal rnam par 'gyur ba can/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba/ mtshogs ma'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub bcas pa'i phyag g.yas brkyangs shing khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yon gyis yab la 'khyud pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril bar bsam mo// 'di'i man ngag tu yab la sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla phyed nor bu ma gtogs pa'i rgyan dang bral ba/ yum rgyan dang bcas par bshad la/ slob dpon a bha yās ni/ yab la phyag rgya drug dang nor bu dang zla ba phyed pa dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa ral pa'i thor cog can du bzhed do// de ltar skad cig gis bskyed pa'i spyi bo mi bskyod pas rgyas btab la/ thugs kar nyi ma la rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lta bar nyi ma la hūm̐ dkar po ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i ngo bor bsams te/ ji srid mi skyo'i bar du yid mnyam par gzhag go /de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pas sems can thams cad skal ba ci lta ba bzhin du smin par byas/ slar 'dus te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par bsams la/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa ḍā ki ni/ dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas so// mthar rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad stong pa nyid du byas te/ rang gis bsgoms pa'i srung 'khor la bsdu/ de yang rang la/ de yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ de yang rim gyis nā da'i bar bsdus la/ nā da yang mi dmigs par byas pa'i ngang la sems mnyam par gzhag de nas skad cig gis lhan cig skyes pa'i skur langs la thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor bya'o// rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor 'di las dang po pas bsgom bya ma yin gyi/

bskyed rim cung zad brtan pas nyams su blang bya yin pa'i phyir dang*/ mig dang sku la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ ye shes pa dgugs gzhug la sogs pa mi dgos shing*/ lha'i bskyed tshul yang ye shes kyi bskyed pa yin gyi/ bskyed rim ltar sngags kyi bskyed pa ma yin pas cho ga 'di la dbri bsnan pa mi bya'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ sha chang dang bcas pa'i gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ thod pa chen por sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab bo// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa phaiṃ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang chos skyong dang 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki n+ya/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lnga'am bdun gyis phul nas/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa'i// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod cing gsol ba btab pas/ ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub gnang bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas gshegs su gsol zhing*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma yod na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas bsngo'o// kha zas za ba'i tshe gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang he ru ka dmigs pa'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me 'bar ba'i me lce'i khrod du/ snying gar bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang lto bar 'jig rten pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dmigs nas/

thog mar phud kyis bla ma dang yi dam la mchod la/ de nas kha thab khung du bsams par phul nas lus kyi lha rnams mnyes par bsam zhing bza'o// de nas lhag ma/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes pas lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no// spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang he ru ka la/ phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad mchod pa'i lha mor dmigs pa rnams kyis 'dod yon gyi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ kha na ma tho ba med par ci bde bar spyod do// nyal ba'i tshe snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyi rol 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bsdus nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus kyang snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ stong pa nyid du thim pa'i ngang la nyal lo// ldang ba'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rang skad cig gis he ru kar gyur pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud gsal bar dmigs nas ldang bar bya ste/ ye shes kyi sku bskyed pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa'o// gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu 'di'i rdzogs rim don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams la byin rlabs kyi cho ga byed par 'dod na/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis gang yang rung ba la/ dben pa'i gnas su phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ rdo rje dril bu nang mchod rnams bsham/ de nas slob dpon gyis gong sgrub thabs su bstan pa ltar/ bdag nyid lhar bsgoms pa nas gtor ma'i bar byas la/ slob ma slob dpon lu hi pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char pa gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes pa lan gsum gyis phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su song nas/

don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba// nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa// srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa'i nyon mongs chod mdzod la// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de dag bdag la grub par mdzod// ces lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo// de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs kyis rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// che ge dus 'di nas bzung nas// ji srid gnyis med la gnas pa// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par srungs// zhes pa rnams lan gsum re brjod pas sdom pa gzung ngo*// de nas slob dpon skad cig gis bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa sngar bshad pa bzhin nam/ yang na seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ bla ma bcom ldan 'das bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi gdan la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa'i 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bar dmigs la/ de'i dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po rnams dmigs la/

de dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rjer bsgoms la mos gus drag po byed du gzhug go /de nas slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ yig las 'od zer dkar po spros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs nas/ spyi bo'i oṃ yig la thim pas/ oṃ yig de sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku'i rang bzhin du bsams la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag gi lus la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab pas/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ yig las oṃ yig gi phreng ba bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po dang bcas pa byon/ slob ma'i dpral bar thim pas lus byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ rol mo'i sgra dang gu gul gyi dud pa bya zhing*/ snying po brjod pas ye shes dbab bo// de las byung ba'i nyams byung rgyal du btang la/ bum pa'i dbang thob zhes brda sprad do// de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥyig gis gsang dbang dang*/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gis shes rab ye shes dang*/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum char gyis dbang bzhi pa rnams bum dbang gi 'gros kyis shes par byas la bskur ro// mjug tu yon phul ba dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung bar gdams pa rnams byas la/ tshogs kyi 'khor lor longs spyod/ byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga ste/ bla ma dag gi phyag bzhes ltar bris pa'o// de ltar byin rlabs kyis smin par byas pa'i gang zag nyung ngu'i rnal 'byor la mos pa dag 'di'i rdzogs rim bsgom par 'dod na/ bla ma dpyal a mo ghas mdzad pa'i khrid yig ltar nyams su blang bar bya zhing*/ man ngag de dag gzhung gang gis bstan snyam na/ slob dpon lu hi pa'i bde mchog gi sgrub thabs las/ ā li kā li mdun bsams nas// zhes sogs rdzogs rim ston pa'i gzhung cung zad cig gsungs pa'i don yin te/

de la rten la dmigs pa ni/ ā li kā li mdun bsams nas// rnal 'byor chen pos ngal bso te// zhes te/ kā li ni thabs te bde mchog dkar po/ de'i mdun du ā li ni shes rab ste/ rdo rje phag mo bsgom pa'o// ngal bso ba ni sngar bskyed rim skabs su spros pa sna tshogs kyi yid dub pa ste/ rdzogs rim bsgoms pas ngal bso ba'o// gnyis pa brten pa la dmigs pa la gnyis kyi dang po yig 'bru la gtad pa ni/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ni// lte ba'i rtsa bar gnas par bsam// yi ge rnams kyi mchog gyur pa// de yi dbus su gnas par bsam// zhes te/ lte ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dang*/ 'khor lo gzhan rnams la yi ge'i mchog dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams 'god pa'o// gnyis pa thig le la gtad pa ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// lha yi sku ni bsgom par bya// zhes te/ yig 'bru rnams las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo gsum dang rdo rje can gtso bo yab yum rnams mdun du spyan drangs nas rang la thim par bsgom pa'o// bzhag pa sems kyi ngo bo ni// gong bu las ni 'das gyur kyang*// dngos po med pa'i sems nyid min// de yang bsam gyis mi khyab bsam// sems nyid brtag par mi bya'o// bsam gyis mi khyab de bsams na// de las gzungs nyid thob par 'gyur// zhes te/ thig le'i gong bu'i gzugs las 'das nas dbu mar bcug pas bde ba chen po skye ba ni dngos po med pa'i sems nyid yin la/ bde ba chen po de yang spros pa dang mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid du shes pa ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don bsam pa'o// don de la rtag chad dang yod med sogs mtha' gang du'ang brtag par mi bya la/ bsam mi khyab pa'i don de bsgoms pas bzung ba ni/ dha ra zhes pa 'dzin par yang 'gyur bas/ bde stong sku bzhi'i gzugs 'dzin pa'i dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang nyid thob par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'o// de ltar na slob dpon lū hi pa'i gzhung gis man ngag yin pas/

lū hi pa'i rdzogs rim yin la/ slob dpon pra dzñā rak+ṣi ta/ bi bhū ta tsan+d+ra/ jo bo a dwe ṣa rnams kyi lū hi pa'i bshad pa dang cung zad mi mthun par snang yang*/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nyid kyis rdo rje phag mo las dngos su gsan pa'i man ngag thun mong ma yin par snang ngo*// nges don he ru ka yi sgrub pa'i thabs// ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa'i man ngag ltar// ma sbas gsal bar bkod pa'i dge ba des// ma gyur 'gro bas rdo rje 'chang thob shog /dpal bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang bcas pa 'di ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos bla ma snga ma rnams kyi yi ge dang*/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i bshad pas brgyan nas go bde bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong bsod nams rin chen zhes bya bas bgyis so// i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu// // ༄༅// 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i gdams ngag dngos grub kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rab 'byams rgyud sde'i tshogs la dbang 'byor pas// ji snyed dngos grub sgrub pa'i man ngag rnams// skal ldan 'gro la ma nor gsal mdzad pa// rje btsun sa skya pa rnams spyi bos mchod// bde mchog 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud chen dang*// bshad pa'i rgyud las byung ba'i gdams ngag kun// rje btsun mchog gis bsdus pa'i gsung rab kyi// gsal byed 'chi med sgrub pa'i gdams ngag bri// 'dir dge ba spyod pa'i gang zag rnams kyi srog ni shin tu gces pa yin te/ gang phyir 'di na yid 'ong ba// srog las gzhan pa yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// srog de nyid la dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa tshe'i bar chad du ma 'byung bas/

de bslu ba dang srog 'tsho ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos te/ brtse med 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las// thar pa'i thabs ni 'bad de bya// zhes pa ltar ro// des na 'khor bar srog las gces pa ni// ci yang yod par ma mthong ste// de bas myur du thabs mang pos// 'chi ba bslu ba kun tu spyad// gang phyir rigs par thabs sbyar bas// dka' ba cung zad yod ma yin// nor bu sngags dang sman rnams kyis// mthu ni thams cad 'dod pa yin// 'chi ba'i mtshan nyid las rig nas// shes par byas la rigs pas bcos// zhes pa ltar tshe bsring ba'i thabs la nan tan du bya'o// de'i gdams ngag 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa'i dgongs pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud nges brjod bla ma'i le'u nyer gcig pa dang nyer gnyis par gsungs pa'i man ngag grub pa'i dbang phyug nā ro pa chen po'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi/ dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyi man ngag ltar bshad pa la don gnyis te/ thog mar 'chi ltas brtag pa dang*/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i man ngag dngos so// dang po ni/ 'chi bslu'i gzhung dang*/ dpal bir+wa pa'i man ngag tu bshad pa ltar/ 'chi rtags kyi man ngag rnams zhib tu shes dgos la/ 'dir mdor bsdus pa 'di tsam zhig gsungs te/ de yang 'chi ltas kyi rigs kha cig la ni/ mig gi sna rtse mi mthong*/ rang gi mkhrig ma mi mthong*/ nyin mo skar ma mthong*/ mtshan mo gzha' tshon mthong*/ zla zer me ltar tsha/ nyi zer chu ltar grang*/ nyi zla'i steng du bu ga mthong*/ rang gi khu ba nag por mthong*/ rang mi yo bar grib ma g.yo ba la sogs par mthong ba'ang gsungs/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ phyi'i rnal 'byor gyi tshe sgrub pa dang*/ nang gi rnal 'byor gyi tshe sgrub pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ bsgom bzlas kyi/ sbyin sreg gi bum chog gi 'khor lo'i sgo nas tshe sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ gnas dben par mtshams dam du byas la thun bzhi'i nges pas sgrub thabs ltar bsgom pa dang bzlas pa tshul bzhin du bya'o// 'on kyang der mi gsal ba cung zad bshad na/

rgyun bshags kyi tshig lo hi pa ltar ram/ ma nus na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis btub/ phung khams skye mched byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ khro bo bcu bsgoms nas phur bu gdab pa'i bar nyams len rgyun pa la mi mdzad/ nyi ma'i steng du ces pa dpe mang po la snang yang*/ dpe kha cig la bzla bar yod pa dag pas zla gdan du bya/ zhal brgyad ma dang bzhi ma gdam kha can du gsungs kyang*/ brgyad ma phyag len la mdzad/ sngags don cung zad bshad na/ oṃ ni tshe'i dpal ster ba'i don to// a mṛ ta/ 'chi med/ saṃ/ nye bar/ dzī ba ni/ 'tsho ba/ ma hā a mṛ ta/ 'chi med chen po/ su mu khe/ legs par zhal du/ dzī waṃ/ 'tsho ba/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ phob cig sarba/ thams cad/ badz+ra pad+ma/ rdo rje dang pad+ma/ sa ma yo ge mnyam par sbyor ba/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta/ byang chub kyi sems chen po/ bi pi ta/ rnam par 'thung ba mūrte sku/ hūm̐ ring po gnyis ni thabs shes dbyer med/ a ā aṃ aḥha/ tshe sgrub kyi sngags kyi sham bu yin la/ swā hā ni gzhi tshugs shig ces pa'o// de ltar bsgom bzlas la brten nas bsnyen pa khri'am 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas pas 'chi ba 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// thun mtshams su phyi rol mchod pa byed na/ maṇ+ḍal chang gi byugs la/ dbus su me tog gi tshom bu bkod la/ mtha' skor du mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma bde mchog ltar bsham/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod dang rdo rje dang dril bu yang bkod do// de nas mdun gyi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ maṇ+ḍal la bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ las sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ thugs kar 'khor lo bsgom/ ye shes pa bcug dbang bskur te mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de la/ oṃ bha ga wa ti badz+ra de wi sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis/

nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ rgyal ba gang gi thugs rje yis// dus min 'chi ba zhi 'gyur cing*// 'chi ba las ni nges slong mdzad// 'chi med dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces pas bstod/ gtor ma dang po lu hi pa'i sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun bskyed gyi lha mo'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can las 'od zer byung bas gtor ma la zug ste bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can de gsol bas tshim zhing tshe'i dngos grub stsol bar bsams la/ sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ma ā yur s+sid+dhi pra yats+tshan+tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ slar yang phyi nang gis mchod/ sngar bzhin bstod la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs kyis phrin las gzhol lo// gtor ma gnyis pa rdo rje nag po chen po la phul la/ tshe yi bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las gzhol/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis bsngo/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa byed par 'dod na/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dpag tu med pa byung ba 'khor lo la bstim/ de las byung ba'i 'chi med kyi chu rgyun bdag gis kha dang ba spu'i bu ga'i sgo thams cad nas zhugs par bsams la gsang sngags ci nus bzlas/ mthar bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes dngos grub blangs la/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥdam tshig pa rang gi sna bug g.yon nas snying gar bsdu ba sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams tshul bzhin du bya'o// de ltar bsnyen pa sngon du song nas tshe'i rdzing bu kha gso ba'i phyir du/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa ma chags par nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa sbyin sreg gi sgo nas tshe sgrub pa ni/

bsnyen pa byed pa'i gnas de nyid dam gzhan du'ang rung ste/ sa phyogs dri zhim pos byug par rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po khru do gru bzhi pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran sor brgyad pa la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa dang*/ zur bzhir zla byed rin chen dang dbus su rin po che cha dgu pa bri/ der 'bras bu can gyi shing ngam/ nags kyi ba lang gi lci ba srog chags med pas thab brtsig me tshang bca'/ thab kyi g.yon du mchod pa dang*/ g.yas su mar dang yam shing dang*/ dūr ba dang zas mchog rnams bsham/ rdo rje dril bu dang dgang gzar blugs gzar mdun du bzhag ste sbyor ba'o// de nas rang nyid bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pas me sbar te thab tshul bzhin du bskyed pa'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ skad cig gis me lha sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsam/ de la mchod pas mchod nas/ oṃ ag+na ye ma ma ā yur puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ swā hā/ zhes pas mar dang*/ dūr ba dang*/ zas mchog rnams gsum gsum phul la/ drang srong chen pos bdag gi tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig ces phrin las bcol bas/ 'bar bar gyur par bsams te 'jig rten pa'i me lha thog mar mchod pa'o// de nas thab kyi dbus su pad zla'i gdan la lha mo skad cig gis bskyed pa nas rgyas gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la mchod pas mchod/ lha mo'i thugs kar 'khor lo la dmigs nas/ de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshe'i ngo bor mos pas/ lha mo'i sngags kyi mthar ma ma ā yur puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ swā hā/ zhes btags la/ mar dang*/ dūr ba dang*/ zas mchog rnams brgya dang brgyad re dbul/ de nas mchod pas mchod de/ bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/

lha mo rang gi snying gar bsdus te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i cho ga'o// de nas me lha skad cig gis dmigs te bsreg rdzas lhag ma ci 'byor pa phul la/ mchod cing gsol ba btab nas mi dmigs par bsams te 'jig rten pa'i me lha lhag mas mchod pa ste dngos gzhi'o// de nas longs yod na me ma shi'i bar du stan de nyid las mi g.yo bar bzlas pa bya/ ma grub na dge ba bsngo ba sogs byas la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdus te rjes kyi bya ba'o// bsnyen pa kha skong du byed na/ gsang sngags 'bum phrag gcig la ni// sbyin sreg khri phrag bya bar bshad// ces pa'i grangs dūr ba kho na la gzung ngo*// gsum pa bum bzlas kyi sgo nas tshe sgrub pa ni/ gnas dben par gzhi bzang po'i steng du bum pa nang rdzas dung chos rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bde mchog bzhin bsham/ mchod pa dang gtor ma sogs phyi rol mchod pa ltar bshams la/ rang nyid bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ bum pa bsang sbyangs te/ nang du hūm̐ las lha mor bskyed pa nas rgyas gdab pa'i bar bya/ de la phyi dang nang dang bstod pas mchod la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim/ de las byung ba'i bdud rtsi lha mo'i ba spu'i bu ga nas 'dzag pas bum pa'i nang 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang bar bsams la gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ gsang sngags ci nus bzlas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod/ gtor ma dang po phul la/ dung chos kyi mchod yon phul la/ lha zhu ba las byung ba'i tshe'i chu rgyun du 'gyur bar bsam/ de nas chos skyong dang mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma bsngo ba sogs phyi rol mchod pa ltar byas la/

bum pa'i chu de bdag nyid kyis 'thung zhing bkru ba dang*/ skye bo gzhan la'ang byin na tshe'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro// bzhi pa 'khor lo'i sgo nas tshe sgrub pa la gsum/ bri ba/ sgrub pa/ gdags pa'o// dang po ni/ tshe rgyas pa'i 'khor lo'i bri gzhi shog bu'am/ 'grel par rgyas pa'i 'khor lo ras ser po la bri bar bshad pas/ ras 'dul ser po'am dar 'dul ser po la yang rung ngo*// snag tsha ni/ gur gum mam/ gi wang bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pas bya'o// ji ltar bri ba'i tshul sgrub thabs su gsol lo// las 'jam po rnams la yig mgo nang bstan dang*/ drag po'i las la yig mgo phyir bstan du bri bar bshad pa yang*/ sngon gyi brda rnying la mgo dang kha don gcig tu byas pa ltar yin la/ skad gsar bcad ltar mgo dang kha so so ba'i dbang du byas na/ kha che dzñā na shrīs/ zhi rgyas bsrung dang dbang bya la// yig mgo phyir bstan mngon spyod la// de las bzlog par shes par bya// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa bsgrub pa la gnyis las/ dang po rab gnas kyi sgrub pa ni/ 'khor lo de zangs gzhong 'bru yis bkang ba'i steng du bzhag la/ 'khor lo spyi'i rab gnas bde mchog ltar bya'o// gnyis pa 'khor lo'i sgrub pa dngos ni/ gser dngul gyi bum pa'am ga 'u'i nang ngam/ ma 'byor na so ma btang ba'i kham phor kha sbyar gyi nang du 'khor lo skud pa ser pos rgya gram du dkri/ dūr ba dang bdud rtsi lnga dang dkar gsum la sogs pas dgang ba'i kham phor du gzhag de rgyas pa'i maṇ+ḍal ser po khru do gru bzhi pa bris pa'i steng du bzhag la gzungs thag btags te/ 'khor lo lha mor bskyed pa sogs phyi rol mchod pa ltar bya/ gzungs thag nas bzung la rtsa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ mchod pa lnga dang dūr ba gzhon nu dbul/ de ltar zhag bdun du sgrub la/ mthar lha mo zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lor bltas la/ khyim gyi phyogs gcig tu bzhag na tshe rgyas pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro// gsum pa gdags pa ni/

sgrub pa byas pa'i 'khor lo de gdags pa'am/ yang na rab gnas tshul bzhin du byas pa'i 'khor lo zhig mgul lam dpung pa g.yas par bcings na mchog gi tshe ster bar 'gyur ro// de dag gis ni phyi'i rnal 'byor gyi tshe sgrub pa'i man ngag thams cad bstan zin to// gnyis pa nang gi rnal 'byor gyi tshe sgrub pa la gnyis sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ mdun du bla ma bde mchog yab yum du bsgom pa la maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing tshe rgyas par gsol ba gdab pa zhag 'ga' zung bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ bskyed rim la brten pa'i tshe sgrub dang*/ rdzogs rim la brten pa'i tshe sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ sgrub thabs ltar bsgom bzlas tshul bzhin du byas pa'i rjes su/ rang rdo rje lha mor gsal ba'i thod pa'i nang spyi gtsug tu haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan bsam/ spyi bo'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po dbyug pa'i sbom sa'i dbus su hūm̐ dkar pos mtshan par bsams nas/ ngo bo lha mo la rnam pa phyag mtshan kha ṭ+wāṃ gar nges shes bskyed/ de nas hūm̐ yig las 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs ka nas tshe'i bcud rnam pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du spyan drangs/ hūm̐ la thim de las byung ba'i chu rgyun gyis kha ṭ+wām̐ ga'i nang gang*/ de gnyis las byung ba'i chu rgyun gyis spyi gtsug gi haṃ la reg de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te snying ga'i 'khor lo la bstim/ de las byung ba'i bdud rtsi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad khengs pas tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ thun gyi mthar/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga hūm̐ dang bcas pa bdud rtsir zhu nas rang la thim par bsam mo// 'di ni/ dus min 'chi las rnam rgyal ba// yan lag kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang sbyar// thod pa mchod yon snod du ni// zhal du mtshon char nges par sbyar// zhes pa'i dgongs pa phyogs gcig yin no// gnyis pa la gsum las/
