dang po srog rtsol gyis 'chi ba bslu ba ni/ tho rangs kyi dus rlung gang nas rgyu bltas la/ g.yas nas rgyu na nu ma bcud la bor ba'i thabs kyis g.yon du bsgyur/ des kyang ma 'gyur na khu tshur brang du bsnol la mig steng du blta zhing*/ shes pa 'di bsam med par bzhag pas 'gyur ro// de nas zhag nyer gcig tu tho rangs lha mor dran pas sna g.yon nas rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe nang du zhugs zhes bsam/ de bzhin du nang du gnas/ phyir 'thon zhes srog rtsol gyi rlung khugs pa nyer gcig nyer gcig byas na/ zla ba gcig tu nur/ zla ba gcig tu brgya rtsa brgyad brgyad bsgoms na lo gcig nur/ lo gcig tu stong rtsa brgyad byas na tshe tshad ci yod tsam zhig nur ro// 'di ni/ thabs la mkhas par gyur pa yis// rlung gi bzlas pa brtson par bya// nangs par langs nas stong phrag gcig /rtag tu legs par bgrangs nas ni// nad kun las ni rnam grol zhing*// nyi zla gnas kyi bar du 'tsho// zhes pa'i don to// gnyis pa bdud rtsi gso bas bslu ba ni/ rang lha mor gsal ba'i lte bar pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ nangs par g.yon nas rgyu ba'i dus su/ nang du 'jug pa'i rlung de bdud rtsi'i rlung zhes bya ste/ sog ma phra mo tsam kha dog dkar pos zhugs pas/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor thal byung nas lte ba'i pad+ma la thim par bsams te phreng ba gcig bgrang*/ de 'dra ba 'bum zhag bdun la bgrangs na/ zhag bdun na 'chi ba lo lngar bsrings/ nyis 'bum gyi lo bcu/ gsum 'bum gyi lo bco lnga/ bzhi 'bum bgrangs na lo nyi shu bsrings te/ 'bum tsho res lo lnga lnga bsring ba bsgres te shes par bya'o// 'di ni/ 'jug pa'i rlung ni bgrang bya zhing*// rim gyis 'bum sogs grangs kyi ni// rtse gcig sems kyi cho ga ni// sgra med pa yi bzlas par bshad// sgra med bzlas pa 'bum du ni// chos bzhin du ni rdzogs gyur na// mi de tshe nyams gyur pa yang*// lo lnga'i bar du 'tsho bar nges// nyis 'bum la sogs bzlas pa nyid// tshe 'phel bar ni shes par bya// zhes pa'i don to// gsum pa nam mkha' zas su za bas bslu ba ni/

tho rangs ba spu'i bu ga mthong tsam nas nyi ma ma shar gyi bar nyams su len pa ste/ de yang gnas kyi sbyor ba bdun dang ldan pa gces te/ de'ang*/ srog bsdu/ dkrug bsad/ mnyes/ 'then/ brdung*/ nam mkha' btung ba'i sbyor ba'o// dang po kha sbyor lan gsum ni// skyil krung mtshan nyid ldan pa'o// gnyis pa lag g.yas rkang mtheb g.yas// bzung ste cung zad brkyang bar bya// g.yon pa'i rting pas bshang lam bgags// g.yas kyi long mor lag g.yon gyis// bzung ste kha gting dkrug par bya// sbyor ba de nyid klod 'dod na// drag tu stan las 'phar te btang*// gsum pa bsad pa'i sbyor ba'o// bzhi pa lus dang yan lag mnye// lnga pa sgyid khung gnyis nas ni// lag gnyis phyi ru phyung byas la// rkang mtheb gnyis nas 'then pa yi// langs te yang yang 'phar bar bya// drug pa lag gnyis brtan byas la// lus gzhan drag tu brdung bar bya// bdun pa nam mkha' mthong ba'i sar// rngubs te dgang bar bya ba yin// kun la'ang gsum gsum shes par bya// dang por dal bus sbyang byas la// rim gyis je drag je drag bya// mthar ni shin tu drag po'o// zhes pa ltar/ 'khrul 'khor dang po drug sngon du song nas bdun pa dngos gzhi'i skabs su/ rang lha mo'i nga rgyal gyis nam mkha' la shes pa gtad la/ khams gsum gyi nam mkha' thams cad 'od sngon po'i tshul du rang gi kha'i nang du zhugs par bsam/ rlung kha nas sgra med du dgang*/ lus thams cad khrig gis gang ba dang*/ khong pa brgyan nam mkha' sngo sang nge bar bsam/ mchil ma sgra med du mid la rlung thub tshad bzung*/ de ltar yang yang byas pas stong sgregs byung na 'chi ba bslus pa yin gsungs so// 'di ni/ so ni so la ma reg par// rgyu ba'i nus pa bsam mi khyab// dad par byas la 'di tsam bya// zhes dang*/ sbyor bas nam mkha' zas su za// nam mkha' bzhin du 'chi med 'gyur// zhes pa'i don to// 'di dag gi mthar lta ba bdag med pa ci nus su bsgom/

rjes spyod lam gyi gnas skabs su/ lha mo'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam thams cad chos dang mthun pa 'ba' zhig tu bya zhing*/ sems can gyi tshe srog bslu ba dang*/ gzhan la kha zas sbyin pa la nan tan du bya'o// de dag gis ni rdzogs rim la brten nas tshe sgrub pa'i man ngag rnams bstan zin to// de ltar 'chi med dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs// rgyud dang mkhas pa'i man ngag ci bzhin du// 'khrul med go bde'i ngag gis bshad pa yis// dge ba gang des ma lus 'gro ba dang*// skul byed rtsom pa po dang bcas rnams kyi// dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad kun zhi nas// 'chi med sku bzhi'i dpal gyis mngon 'byor pa// bde mchog 'khor lo'i go 'phang 'thob gyur cig /'chi med sgrub pa'i gdams ngag 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud don bzhin du/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi gsal byed 'di ni/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gyis rgyud phyug pa'i bdag nyid rgyud sde 'dzin pa chen po bla ma kun dga' legs pa'i gsung gis nan tan bskul ba la brten nas rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos mngon brjod bla ma'i rgyud rtsa 'grel dang*/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdams ngag thor bur gnas pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas bskul pa po nyid kyi sku rim du dmigs te dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'o// bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas man ngag 'di nyams su len nges pa'i slob ma gsum las mang ba la dus gcig tu mi sbyin par gsang zhing dpe yang snod dang mi ldan pa la gsang zhing sba bar bya'o// 'dis rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi sku tshe rgyas par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ bde mchog sbyangs pa'i yon tan lha bcu gsum gyi mngon rtogs la dgos pa'i zin bris 'di bla mas mdzad pa yin no//

༈ /de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i gri gug gi rwa bas bskor ba'i lte bar/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan brtsegs pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ro'i snying gar zla ba'i gdan/ mtshams bzhir bum pa'i steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa mtshams kyi grwa bzhi'i sgo rnams su ro'i snying gar zla ba'i gdan/ dus mtshan ma'i snying gar nyi ma'i steng du ā li phrag gnyis g.yon skor du mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du kā li phrag gnyis g.yas skor dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du hūm̐ dngul chu'i mdog lta bu yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ baṃ las gri gug bam̐ gyis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ zla nyi phyag mtshan dang bcas pa gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bdag nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa rtsa zhal mthing nag g.yon ser po g.yas dmar po steng zhal ljang ba gzhan lha lnga ma bzhin phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon dang chos gos te mi'i pags pa phyi nang du 'phyar nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na rdo rje lcags kyu/ lnga pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ drug pa na chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na 'khar gsil/ bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ gzhan lha lnga ma bzhin/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa'o// de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo// gzhan lha lnga ma la phyag g.yon par ro'i

'di'i lhung bzed dang 'khar gsil ni thod pa dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la bya'o/ /gtso 'khor kun gyi'o// lhung bzed/ g.yas pas chos sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ de nas shar gyi 'dab ma la/ ma taṃ gi ser mo/ byang du ḍom+bi ni sngon mo/ nub tu rā dza gi dmar mo/ lho ru puk+ka sī dud kha/ thams cad g.yon rnams kyis 'khar gsil dang*/ g.yas pa rnams kyis ḍā ma ru dang gri gug 'dzin pa/ mtshams bzhir rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi/ shar lho'i grwar ba dha ki dmar skya/ lho nub tu/ sa ha tsa ri dmar mo/ nub byang du/ bu dhi tsi ri ljang gu/ byang shar du sha ba ri dmar mo rnams g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang 'khar gsil/ g.yas gnyis kyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa/ sgo bzhi'i shar sgor/ he ru ka'i 'od ma thal kar/ byang sgor rdo rje gtum mo ljang gu/ nub sgor rdo rje srin mo dmar mo/ lho sgor rdo rje 'jigs byed ma sngon mo/ phyag g.yon pa rnams kyis lhung bzed dang 'khar gsil/ g.yas pa rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo dang ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa'o// bzhad pa zhi ba snying rje can// sgeg pa dang rngam pa dang mi sdug pa drag shul khro bo'i nyams dang ldan pa'o// sgo ma bzhi ni lang 'tsho gzhon zhing nu ma rgyas pa'o// kun kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma'o// skyil krung phyed pa'i gar can skra grol ba gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa thams cad kyang thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'o// de nas go cha ye shes pa dbang rnams 'dra la/ rigs bdag gtso bo yab yum 'dra la/ ma taṃ gi la sogs pa bzhi la rim pa bzhin/ g.yon skor du/ rnam snang*/ don grub/ 'od dpag med/ rin 'byung dang ba dha ki la sogs la g.yas skor/ rnam snang*/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub/ sgo ma bzhi ni/ ma taṃ gi sogs dang 'dra'o// de nas bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang*/

nye snying dang*/ oṃ ma taṃ gi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ḍom+bi ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rā dza ki hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ puk+ka sī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gzhan rnams la mgo bor oṃ dang*/ mjug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar la/ bi dhā kī/ sa ha tsa rī/ bu dhi tsa rī/ sha ba rī/ he ru ka bhī/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li badz+ra rak+ṣa sī/ oṃ badz+ra bha ra wī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas phreng sngags dang*/ oṃ shrī tsi ta ḍa ka dhṛ ka a khaṃ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sam+bha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī wāk+ka ḍā ka da a ro li ka ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sam+bha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī kā la ḍā ka ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sam+bha ra ru lu ru lu bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī rat+na ḍā ka a oṃ/ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sam+bha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī karmā ḍā ka a khaṃ ḍā ki dz+wa la sam+bha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gtso bo lnga'i sngags so// gzhan rnams thams cad dril bu lha lnga ma dang 'dra'o// lung du bstan dang tshigs su bcad// ched du brjod dang gleng gzhi dang*// rtogs brjod de lta bur byung dang*// skyes pa rabs dang shin tu rgyas// rmad du byung dang gtan la dbab// gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis te// rnal 'byor ma yi ngo bo nyid// bsod snyoms pa dang chos gos gsum// phyis mi len dang tsog pu pa// stan gcig pa dang bla khab med// shing drung pa dang bas mthar gnas// dur khrod pa dang phyag dar khrod// phying ba pa dang gzhi ji bzhin// sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis te// rnal 'byor ma rnams rnam par dag/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs dang bde mchog nag po pa'i sgrub thabs kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bzhugs so// ༈ /na maḥshrī tsakra saṃ bha rā ya/ bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ni/ phal che ba bde mchog nag po pa'i sgrub thabs dang 'dra la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyi chos rnams bshad na/

thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ shrī he ru ka a haṃ gis don dran pa nas tshogs zhing gshegs pa'i bar 'dra/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgoms te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags 'dra/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid nam mkha'i dbyings su yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par gnas pa la/ de'i rnam 'phrul gyis sprul pa'i 'og tu paṃ las pad+ma bskyed pa nas/ srung 'khor gyi bar 'dra/ de nas e las chos 'byung bskyed pa nas/ gdung mig mangs ris su bris pa'i bar 'dra/ de'i nang mchod rten zlum po bang rim bzhi pa lta bu'i pad+ma rim pa bzhi gnas te/ phyi rol sku'i pad+ma dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i rwa ba sogs dang*/ bar ma gsung gi pad+ma dmar po sogs/ nang ma thugs kyi pad+ma sngon po sogs thams cad kyang 'dab ma brgyad pa/ 'og gzhi gi kha dog sngon po/ lte bar bde chen gyi 'khor lo ling tshe dgu pa/ rin po che'i mtshan pa'i rwa ba dang*/ ka ba sogs nas dur khrod kyi bar 'dra/ de nas rgyu rdo rje 'chang bskyed pa la mngon byang dang po bzhi 'dra/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og mas kha ṭ+wām̐ ga g.yon 'og mas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje drag byed ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ cha lugs sogs 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra bar bskyed/ de nas yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje bskyed pa nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras nam mkha'i hūm̐ yig spyan drangs zhal du zhugs nas/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos yab yum 'od du zhu nas/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa'i bar 'dra/ de zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa/

rtsa zhal sngo ba/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab ser/ g.yas dkar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum nas/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa nas/ g.yas 'og mas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga g.yon 'og mas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbur brgyan nas/ yab yum gnyis ka ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar 'dra/ de nas zhal bzhi pas byin gyis brlabs pa nas yum la rnam snang gi dbur brgyan pa'i bar 'dra/ de nas mngal du dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ yab kyi thig le dang*/ yum gyi rak+ta 'dres pa las byung ba'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa las/ cha gcig bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang yongs su rdzogs par bsam/ thig le cha gcig cha so bdun du gyur pa so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa las/ dbus kyi thig le aṃ a las dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang*/ aṃ ā las byung ba'i yum rdo rje phag mor bskyed/ shar gyi thig le i ī las mkha' 'gro ma/ de bzhin du u ū las lā ma/ e ai las khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ o au las gzugs can ma/ ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ las mtshams kyi bum thod bzhi/ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ bzhi las thugs 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi/ tsaṃ tshaṃ dzaṃ dzhaṃ bzhi las mtshams bzhi/ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ bzhi las gsung 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi/ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ bzhi las mtshams bzhi/ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ bzhi las sku 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi/ ngaṃ nyaṃ ṇaṃ naṃ bzhi las mtshams bzhi/ ya ra la wa las sgo ma bzhi/ sha ṣa sa ha las mtshams ma rnams bskyed nas 'byin pa ni/ phyi'i he ru ka'i lte ba'i hūm̐ bsam pa nas/ yum 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa'i bar 'dra/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la/ nang dang phyi'i shar du mkha' 'gro ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ byang du lā ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hī g.yas dmar g.yon ljang*/ nang dang phyi'i lhor gzugs can ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba dang*/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i nang du/

glang po dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ mi dang ba glang rnams bsnams par bsam/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spro ba nas/ gzhal yas khang spro ba'i bar thams cad 'dra/ byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ dbang bskur ba/ mchod pa/ dag pa dran pa sogs thams cad 'dra/ rdzogs rim bsgom tshul/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba'i bar thams cad nag po pa'i sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// zhes pa 'di slob dpon ka la pa chen po'i dgongs pa/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin du rdo rje 'dzin pa chos btsun bzang pos bris pa'i yi ge pa ni rgyu mgon dbon po lags so// dkyil 'khor gyi shar dkar po yin kyang khwa gdong ma sngon mo yin no// // ༄༅// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so/na ༈ /na maḥshrī gu ra we/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs su rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ dngul lam rdza las byas pa'i zhi ba'i thab khung ngam ma 'byor na/ kham phor la sogs pa'i snod dkar por me bzhag 'byor na dmigs pa gsal ba'i ched du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku sbugs can bzhag ma 'byor na med kyang rung*/ bsreg sder zhig tu/ til nag po ci ltar 'tshams pa gzhag go /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis thab khung stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyar khru gang pa/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi pa la rdo rje rtse lnga pa zlum pos mtshan pa/ lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs mnabs pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbarjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbyer med du bstim/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de nas mdun du til 'du byas nas/ rang gi rkang mthil du yaṃ las rlung*/ lte bar gtum mo'i me/ snying gar kaṃ rlung gis me bskyod pas snying ga'i sdig pa'i sa bon kaṃ nag po las/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsdus/ sna sgo gnyis nas sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par thon/ mdun gyi til la thim/ de bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du phul bas/ sdig pa thams cad zad par bsams la/ til mtheb srin re 'bul zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ mthar badz+ra ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/

shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod nas/ gang gi thugs rje me dpung 'bar ba'i mthus// chags sogs nyes pa'i bud shing kun bsregs shing*// bde chen ye shes snang ba rgyas mdzad pa// bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhabs la 'dud// ces pas bstod/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'khod par shog /ces pas dge ba bsngos la/ me dang thal ba mi 'gom pa'i sar bzhag 'di dag rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u bzhi bcu rtsa drug par/ slob ma yi ni rkang mthil du// gzhu 'dra rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam// lte bar ye shes me 'bar bas// de yi 'od zer snying gar 'bar// 'bar ba snying gar 'khrigs par bsgom// kaṃ las byung ba'i mi sdug gzugs// sdig pa sna yi sgo nas dbyung*// de nas khro bo'i gzugs bsgoms la// des ni kun nas za bar bsgom// oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swā hā/ zhes gsungs pa'i gdams ngag rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi gsung rab las btus pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
